examples.zh: 孩子们举着基督之光烛果走进黑暗。

examples.zh: 倒数日历每天藏一块巧克力。

examples.zh: 平安夜满是松枝与油香。

examples.zh: 苏格兰跨年要闹上两晚。

examples.zh: 彭斯之夜少不了羊杂布丁与诗。

examples.zh: 煎饼日以翻饼比赛收场。

examples.zh: 大斋期里她戒了咖啡。

examples.zh: 忏悔星期二要清空柜里的油脂鸡蛋。

examples.zh: 受难日下着细雨,吃着十字包。

examples.zh: 五朔节的舞者围着花柱转圈。

examples.zh: 冬青花环装点着门面。

meaning: vt. 告发, 起诉, 彻底进行, 执行, 从事;vi. 告发, 起诉, 作检察官

examples.en: The state decided to prosecute the company for dumping toxic waste.
examples.zh: 州政府决定起诉该公司倾倒有毒废料。

examples.en: Young children often cannot differentiate between advertising and regular programs.
examples.zh: 幼儿常常无法区分广告和普通节目。

meaning: vt. 征募, 参与, 谋取;vi. 从军, 应募, 赞助

examples.en: Charities enlist volunteers to teach basic literacy in rural villages.
examples.zh: 慈善机构招募志愿者在乡村教授基础读写。

meaning: n. 少年, 少年读物;a. 少年的, 不成熟的, 适于少年的

examples.en: The court handles juvenile cases separately from adult criminal trials.
examples.zh: 法院将未成年人案件与成人刑事审判分开处理。

meaning: n. 饵, 诱惑;vt. 引诱, 诱惑

examples.en: Cheap flights lure thousands of tourists to the island every winter.
examples.zh: 廉价航班每年冬天吸引成千上万的游客来到该岛。

meaning: n. 织布机, 若隐若现的景象;vi. 朦胧地出现, 隐约可见, 可怕地出现

examples.en: Dark clouds loom over the valley before every summer storm.
examples.zh: 每场夏季暴风雨来临前，乌云都会笼罩山谷。

meaning: n. 巫婆, 女巫;vt. 施巫术, 迷惑

examples.en: In the story, a kind witch helps the lost traveler.
examples.zh: 在故事里，一位善良的女巫帮助了迷路的旅人。

meaning: n. 清楚, 明晰;透明度; 透明性; 清晰性

examples.en: The manager explained the new schedule with surprising clarity.
examples.zh: 经理把新日程解释得异常清楚。

meaning: a. 生动的, 轮廓分明的, 绘画似的, 图解的;图形的

examples.en: The report includes a graphic showing the rise in global temperatures.
examples.zh: 报告中有一幅图表展示全球气温的上升。

meaning: n. 支架, 括弧, 托架;vt. 装托架, 括入括弧

examples.en: Families in this income bracket qualify for the new tax credit.
examples.zh: 属于这一收入区间的家庭有资格享受新的税收抵免。

meaning: n. 啜饮, 小口喝, 抿;vi. 啜饮

examples.en: She likes to sip coffee slowly while reading the morning paper.
examples.zh: 她喜欢一边慢慢啜饮咖啡一边读晨报。

meaning: a. 传说的, 寓言般的, 难以置信的

examples.en: The hotel offers a fabulous view of the mountains at sunrise.
examples.zh: 这家酒店日出时的山景美得令人惊叹。

meaning: vt. 抹去, 擦掉;清洗; 擦除; 抹除; DOS内部命令:从磁盘上删除一个或多个文件

examples.en: Nothing could erase the memory of that terrible summer storm.
examples.zh: 什么也无法抹去那个可怕夏季风暴的记忆。

meaning: vt. 位于...之下, 成为...的基础

examples.en: Two key assumptions underlie the author's entire argument about economic growth.
examples.zh: 两个关键假设构成了作者关于经济增长的全部论证的基础。

meaning: n. 海洛因, 吗啡;海洛因; 二醋吗啡; 二乙酰吗啡

examples.en: The clinic offers treatment programs for people addicted to heroin.
examples.zh: 该诊所为海洛因成瘾者提供治疗方案。

meaning: n. 动脉, 干道, 要道;动脉

examples.en: The surgeon cleared a blocked artery to restore normal blood flow.
examples.zh: 外科医生疏通了堵塞的动脉以恢复正常血流。

meaning: n. 渔业;捕鱼, 捕鱼权

examples.en: The coastal fishery collapsed after years of unregulated deep water trawling.
examples.zh: 经过多年无监管的深海拖网捕捞，沿海渔业崩溃了。

meaning: vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留脑中;嵌入

examples.en: Engineers embed tiny sensors in the bridge to monitor stress.
examples.zh: 工程师在桥内嵌入微型传感器以监测应力。

meaning: n. 奖券, 彩票, 运气;抽彩给奖法

examples.en: She won a small prize in the national lottery last month.
examples.zh: 她上个月在国家彩票中中了一个小奖。

meaning: n. 分隔间, 卧车包房, 防水舱隔;隔室, 隔间

examples.en: Keep your passport in the small compartment above your seat.
examples.zh: 把护照放在座位上方的小隔间里。

meaning: n. 联系, 从属关系;父权(判定私生儿的父亲)

examples.en: The journal requires authors to declare any political affiliation before publication.
examples.zh: 期刊要求作者在发表前申报任何政治隶属关系。

meaning: a. 丈夫的, 婚姻的, 夫妇间的;婚姻的

examples.en: The survey asked about income, education, and marital status.
examples.zh: 调查询问了收入、教育和婚姻状况。

meaning: n. 抢先占据, 先人之见, 入神;成见, 注意散漫, 心不在焉

examples.en: The government's chief preoccupation this year is the cost of housing.
examples.zh: 今年政府最关心的问题是住房成本。

meaning: v. 区别, 差别待遇

examples.en: New rules make it harder for employers to discriminate against older workers.
examples.zh: 新规定使雇主更难歧视年长员工。

examples.en: Doctors warned residents not to inhale the smoke from burning fields.
examples.zh: 医生警告居民不要吸入焚烧农田产生的烟雾。

examples.en: Each chromosome carries thousands of genes that guide how cells grow.
examples.zh: 每条染色体都携带数千个指导细胞生长的基因。

meaning: n. 困境, 窘境;vt. 宣誓, 保证

examples.en: The documentary drew attention to the plight of homeless families.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片让人们关注无家可归家庭的困境。

meaning: n. 主要产物, 常用品, 主要要素, 原料, 订书钉, 钩环;a. 主要的, 重要的

examples.en: Rice remains a staple food for more than half the world.
examples.zh: 大米仍是世界一半以上人口的主食。

meaning: a. 值得尊敬的, 荣耀的, 高贵的

examples.en: An honorable judge must treat every defendant with fairness.
examples.zh: 正直的法官必须公平对待每一位被告。

meaning: a. 红外线的;n. 红外线

examples.en: The telescope uses infrared light to study distant, cold stars.
examples.zh: 望远镜利用红外线研究遥远而寒冷的恒星。

examples.en: Visitors stood in awe before the ancient temple's massive stone columns.
examples.zh: 游客们敬畏地伫立在古庙巨大的石柱前。

meaning: vt. 使困扰, 使烦恼, 折磨

examples.en: It is illegal to harass employees because of their age or religion.
examples.zh: 因年龄或宗教而骚扰员工是违法的。

examples.en: The shelter offers daytime services for families with young children.
examples.zh: 收容所为有幼儿的家庭提供日间服务。

meaning: n. 高地, 苏格兰高地

examples.en: Many highland villages still depend on farming and small herds.
examples.zh: 许多高地村庄仍然依靠农耕和小规模畜牧为生。

meaning: n. 演习, 调遣, 策略;v. 调遣, 演习, 用计

examples.en: The pilot performed a difficult maneuver to avoid the sudden storm.
examples.zh: 飞行员做了一个高难度动作以避开突如其来的风暴。

meaning: a. 再发生的, 定期重复的, 循环的;复发的, 再发的, 回归的

examples.en: Recurrent power cuts have crippled small businesses across the town.
examples.zh: 反复停电使全镇的小企业陷入瘫痪。

meaning: vt. 补助, 资助, 贿赂;资助, 津贴, 给...补助金

examples.en: The government agreed to subsidize train tickets for students and seniors.
examples.zh: 政府同意补贴学生和老年人的火车票。

meaning: n. 寄生生物, 寄生虫, 食客;寄生物; 寄生胎

examples.en: The parasite spreads through contaminated water in many rural regions.
examples.zh: 这种寄生虫在许多农村地区通过受污染的水传播。

meaning: n. 侧部, 支线, 边音;a. 侧面的, 旁边的

examples.en: The company encourages lateral moves between departments to build broader skills.
examples.zh: 公司鼓励部门间的平级调动以培养更全面的技能。

meaning: n. 红衣主教, 鲜红色;a. 主要的, 深红色的

examples.en: Respect for evidence is a cardinal rule of scientific research.
examples.zh: 尊重证据是科学研究的一条基本准则。

meaning: n. 欺凌弱小者, 土霸;vt. 威胁, 恐吓, 欺负

examples.en: The workshop teaches children how to respond when a bully threatens them.
examples.zh: 工作坊教孩子们在受到霸凌者威胁时如何应对。

examples.en: They bought a cheaper house on the outskirts of the city.
examples.zh: 他们在市郊买了一套更便宜的房子。

meaning: n. 臭气, 烟, 激怒;vt. 熏

examples.en: Thick fumes from the factory fire drifted across the highway.
examples.zh: 工厂大火产生的刺鼻浓烟飘过了高速公路。

examples.en: He left his briefcase on the train during the morning rush.
examples.zh: 早高峰时他把公文包忘在了火车上。

meaning: vi. 大量存在, 富于, 充满

examples.en: Contradictions abound in the report, according to several independent reviewers.
examples.zh: 多位独立评审认为报告中矛盾之处比比皆是。

meaning: n. 滋味, 风味, 美味, 爱好, 食欲, 调味品;vt. 调味, 喜欢, 玩味

examples.en: She did not relish the idea of working every weekend.
examples.zh: 她并不喜欢每个周末都上班的想法。

meaning: vt.vi. 细看, 仔细检查, 审查, 细阅;细看, 细阅, 仔细检查

examples.en: Auditors will scrutinize every contract signed during the past five years.
examples.zh: 审计人员将仔细审查过去五年签署的每份合同。

examples.en: Many young engineers aspire to lead their own research teams someday.
examples.zh: 许多年轻工程师渴望有朝一日带领自己的研究团队。

examples.en: The city built a garden to commemorate victims of the flood.
examples.zh: 该市修建了一座花园以纪念洪灾遇难者。

meaning: n. 芽, 萌芽;vt. 使发芽, 摘去芽

examples.en: Bean seeds sprout quickly if you keep the soil warm.
examples.zh: 如果保持土壤温暖，豆种很快就会发芽。

meaning: a. 封建制度的, 封地的, 领地的

examples.en: Under the feudal system, peasants farmed land owned by their lords.
examples.zh: 在封建制度下，农民耕种领主的土地。

meaning: n. 孤独, 单独, 孤寂

examples.en: After decades in the city, he sought solitude in the mountains.
examples.zh: 在城市生活几十年后，他到山里寻求独处。

meaning: a. 感伤的, 感情用事的

examples.en: She kept the old letters for purely sentimental reasons.
examples.zh: 她保存那些旧信纯粹是出于情感原因。

examples.en: The railway's modernization cut travel time between the two cities in half.
examples.zh: 铁路现代化使两城之间的旅行时间缩短了一半。

meaning: n. 鞭子, 鞭打, 睫毛, 责骂, 讽刺;vt. 鞭打, 摆动, 扎捆, 冲击, 讽刺, 煽动

examples.en: Autumn storms lash the coast every year, damaging small boats.
examples.zh: 秋季风暴年年袭击海岸，损毁小船。

meaning: v. (巧妙地)逃脱, 规避, 逃避

examples.en: Executives used offshore accounts to evade taxes for nearly a decade.
examples.zh: 高管们利用离岸账户逃税近十年。

examples.en: She completed her doctorate in chemistry at the age of twenty-six.
examples.zh: 她二十六岁完成了化学博士学位。

examples.en: The elderly patient recovered slowly from a severe case of pneumonia.
examples.zh: 老年患者从严重的肺炎中缓慢康复。

meaning: n. 专门术语, 行话, 梦话, 土语;行话

examples.en: The manual is full of technical jargon that confuses ordinary readers.
examples.zh: 这本手册满是让普通读者困惑的专业术语。

meaning: a. 回顾的, 怀旧的, 在后面的;n. 回顾展

examples.en: The gallery staged a retrospective covering forty years of her paintings.
examples.zh: 美术馆举办了涵盖她四十年绘画作品的回顾展。

meaning: vt. 支吾地说;vi. 支吾, 蹒跚地走

examples.en: Her voice began to falter as she described the accident.
examples.zh: 她描述事故时声音开始颤抖。

meaning: n. 素食者, 食草动物;a. 素食的

examples.en: My brother became a vegetarian after watching a documentary about farming.
examples.zh: 看了一部关于农业的纪录片后，我哥哥成了素食者。

meaning: n. 魅力, 迷人的美, 魔法;vt. 迷惑

examples.en: The film strips away the glamor of life in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 这部电影剥去了时尚行业生活的光鲜外表。

meaning: n. 扩大的人(物), 放大器, 扩音器;放大器

examples.en: The band's amplifier broke down ten minutes before the concert began.
examples.zh: 演出开始前十分钟，乐队的扩音器坏了。

meaning: vt. 使丢脸, 使蒙羞, 屈辱

examples.en: The coach would humiliate players in front of the whole team.
examples.zh: 教练会在全队面前羞辱球员。

meaning: a. 无用的, 琐细的, 不重要的

examples.en: Negotiations proved futile, and the strike continued for another month.
examples.zh: 谈判毫无结果，罢工又持续了一个月。

meaning: n. 过失, 流逝, 失效;vi. 犯错, 堕落, 减退, 消失, 流逝

examples.en: A brief lapse in attention caused the driver to miss the exit.
examples.zh: 注意力短暂涣散导致司机错过了出口。

meaning: vt. 阻隔, 妨碍, 阻塞, 遮没;vi. 设障碍

examples.en: Parked cars obstruct the entrance to the fire station every evening.
examples.zh: 每天晚上停放的车辆都会堵住消防站的入口。

meaning: n. 硫, 硫磺;vt. 用硫磺处理

examples.en: The air near the volcano smells of sulfur after every eruption.
examples.zh: 每次喷发后火山附近的空气都有硫磺味。

meaning: a. 神智健全的, 稳健的, 没病的, 合理的;精神健全的

examples.en: No sane investor would put all savings into one risky startup.
examples.zh: 头脑清醒的投资者不会把全部积蓄投入一家高风险初创公司。

meaning: n. 听众席, 礼堂;大讲堂, 大会堂

examples.en: The graduation ceremony filled the university auditorium beyond its usual capacity.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼挤满了大学礼堂，人数超过往常。

meaning: vi. 玩戏法, 行骗, 篡改;vt. 耍弄, 歪曲, 篡改

examples.en: Working parents juggle jobs, meals, and homework every single evening.
examples.zh: 职场父母每天晚上都要在工作、做饭和辅导作业之间忙碌周旋。

meaning: a. 蹒跚的, 巨大的, 惊人的;参差

examples.en: The project required a staggering amount of money and manual work.
examples.zh: 该项目需要惊人的资金和人力。

meaning: n. 尊敬, 尊重;vt. 尊敬, 尊重, 认为

examples.en: The retired teacher is held in high esteem throughout the village.
examples.zh: 这位退休教师在全村深受尊敬。

meaning: vi. 阴谋, 协力, 共谋;vt. 图谋

examples.en: Prosecutors claim the managers conspired to hide the losses.
examples.zh: 检察官称经理们合谋隐瞒亏损。

meaning: a. 高飞的, 翱翔的, 高耸入云的, 崇高的, 高涨的;飞涨的, 高涨的

examples.en: Soaring rents forced several small shops to close this spring.
examples.zh: 飞涨的租金迫使几家小商店今年春天关门。

meaning: vi. 闯入, 侵入;vt. 强加于

examples.en: Reporters must not intrude on the family's grief with constant questions.
examples.zh: 记者不应不断提问去打扰沉浸在悲痛中的家庭。

meaning: a. 决定性的, 确定性的, 最后的;决定性的, 不容置疑的, 确实的

examples.en: The study offers no conclusive evidence that screen time harms memory.
examples.zh: 该研究没有提供屏幕时间损害记忆的确凿证据。

examples.en: The patient reported a sharp pain in his lower abdomen.
examples.zh: 患者自诉下腹部有剧烈疼痛。

examples.en: The charity hired a designer to publicize its winter fundraising campaign.
examples.zh: 慈善机构聘请设计师宣传其冬季募捐活动。

meaning: n. 严格, 严厉, 苛刻, 严酷, 严密, 精确

examples.en: The training program combines academic rigour with practical field experience.
examples.zh: 该培训项目将学术严谨性与实地经验相结合。

meaning: a. 可预知的, 能预测的;可预见的, 可预料的

examples.en: Coal mining will not recover in the foreseeable future, the report warns.
examples.zh: 报告警告说，采煤业在可预见的未来不会复苏。

meaning: n. 激怒, 刺激, 挑拨;激发

examples.en: The guards are trained to stay calm under any provocation.
examples.zh: 警卫受过训练，面对任何挑衅都保持冷静。

meaning: n. 疾驰, 飞奔;vi. 飞驰, 急速进行, 急急忙忙地说

examples.en: The horses gallop across the open field every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 马儿们每天早饭前在开阔的田野上飞奔。

meaning: n. 节约, 茂盛, 海石竹

examples.en: Her thrift allowed the family to survive several hard winters.
examples.zh: 她的节俭让全家熬过了几个艰难的冬天。

meaning: a. 疏忽的, 粗心的, 不在意的

examples.en: The court found the hospital negligent in the child's care.
examples.zh: 法院认定该医院在儿童护理方面存在过失。

meaning: n. 讽刺文学, 讽刺

examples.en: The magazine uses satire to criticize powerful politicians and media companies.
examples.zh: 这家杂志用讽刺来批评有权势的政客和媒体公司。

meaning: n. 爱抚, 拥抱;vt. 爱抚, 抱, 宠爱

examples.en: The grandmother would gently caress the child's hair before bedtime.
examples.zh: 祖母会在睡前轻抚孩子的头发。

meaning: vt. 贯穿, 横穿;vi. 交错, 相交

examples.en: The two highways intersect just north of the industrial park.
examples.zh: 两条高速公路在工业园区以北交汇。

meaning: a. 打扰的, 插入的;闯入的, 侵入的, 干涉的

examples.en: Many users find pop-up advertisements intrusive and deeply annoying.
examples.zh: 许多用户认为弹窗广告具有侵扰性且非常烦人。

meaning: vt. 分解检查, 翻修, 精细检查, 彻底革新;n. 分解检查, 精细检查, 大检修

examples.en: The committee proposed a complete overhaul of the country's tax code.
examples.zh: 委员会提议全面改革国家税法。

meaning: a. 有责任心的, 负责的, 本着良心的;凭良心做的, 有道德感的

examples.en: Conscientious students checked every source before submitting their final essays.
examples.zh: 认真的学生在提交论文前核查了每一处资料来源。

meaning: a. 奋发的, 费劲的, 艰苦的

examples.en: The climb demands strenuous effort even from experienced mountain guides.
examples.zh: 即使对经验丰富的向导，这段攀登也需付出艰苦努力。

meaning: n. 辙迹, 凹槽, 常规, 惯例, 发情期;vi. 交尾, 发情

examples.en: After ten years in the same role, he felt stuck in a rut.
examples.zh: 在同一岗位干了十年后，他感觉陷入了停滞。

meaning: vi. 打瞌睡, 假寐;vt. 打瞌睡度过

examples.en: Grandfather likes to doze in his armchair after the midday meal.
examples.zh: 祖父喜欢在午饭后靠在扶手椅上打盹。

meaning: a. 压抑的, 抑制的, 镇压的

examples.en: Historians studied the repressive measures used by the old regime.
examples.zh: 历史学家研究了旧政权采取的镇压手段。

meaning: vt. 使惊骇, 使吓坏

examples.en: The conditions in the overcrowded prison appal human rights observers.
examples.zh: 拥挤监狱里的状况令人权观察员感到震惊。

meaning: n. 唾液, 唾沫, 涎;涎, 唾液

examples.en: The saliva test can detect the virus within a few minutes.
examples.zh: 这种唾液检测可在几分钟内查出病毒。

meaning: n. 团, 班, 一伙;vi. 巡回演出

examples.en: A traveling theater troupe performs in the village square each summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，一个巡回剧团都会在村庄广场演出。

meaning: vt. 理解, 忧虑, 逮捕;vi. 担心, 理解

examples.en: Officers managed to apprehend the suspect within hours of the robbery.
examples.zh: 警方在劫案发生数小时内就逮捕了嫌疑人。

meaning: a. 卓越的, 出类拔萃的, 超常的;n. 卓越的人, 超绝物

examples.en: Critics praised the pianist's transcendent performance of the long piano concerto.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞钢琴家对这首长协奏曲的超凡演绎。

meaning: a. 知觉的, 有知觉的

examples.en: The lab studies how perceptual skills change as people grow older.
examples.zh: 实验室研究知觉能力如何随年龄增长而变化。

examples.en: He was jailed for attempting to blackmail a famous film producer.
examples.zh: 他因企图敲诈一位著名电影制片人而入狱。

meaning: n. 学者;a. 有读写能力的, 精通文学的, 受过教育的

examples.en: The program aims to make every adult in the region literate.
examples.zh: 该项目旨在让该地区每位成年人都具备读写能力。

meaning: vt. 使摇动, 搅动, 使激动, 使不安;vi. 鼓动, 煽动

examples.en: Rumors of layoffs began to agitate workers across the factory.
examples.zh: 裁员谣言开始使全厂工人不安。

meaning: v. (使)偏振, (使)极化, (使)两极分化

examples.en: The immigration issue continues to polarize public opinion in many countries.
examples.zh: 移民问题继续使许多国家的舆论两极分化。

examples.en: Online debates would improve if users showed more basic civility.
examples.zh: 如果用户表现出更多基本礼貌，网络辩论会得到改善。

meaning: a. 似非而是的, 矛盾的, 诡论的;奇异的, 矛盾的, 逆理的, 反常的

examples.en: It seems paradoxical that spending less now could earn more later.
examples.zh: 现在少花钱以后反而赚得多，这看似矛盾。

meaning: vt. 抢劫, 劫持, 敲诈;挡路抢劫, 抢劫, 绑架

examples.en: Terrorists threatened to hijack the plane shortly after takeoff.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子威胁在起飞后不久劫持飞机。

meaning: n. 狂躁, 热衷, 狂热;躁狂, 狂

examples.en: The tulip mania of the 1630s remains a famous market bubble.
examples.zh: 十七世纪三十年代的郁金香狂热仍是著名的市场泡沫。

meaning: a. 黏合在一起的;内聚的

examples.en: A cohesive team communicates openly and supports each other under pressure.
examples.zh: 有凝聚力的团队沟通坦诚，在压力下互相支持。

examples.en: The precision parts must be accurate to within a single millimeter.
examples.zh: 这些精密零件的精度必须在一毫米以内。

meaning: vt. 使丧胆, 使惊骇

examples.en: Images of the destroyed city appall visitors even decades later.
examples.zh: 即使几十年后，城市被毁的画面仍令参观者震惊。

meaning: a. 有深刻见解的, 富有洞察力的

examples.en: Her insightful comments completely changed the direction of our discussion.
examples.zh: 她富有洞见的评论彻底改变了我们讨论的方向。

meaning: a. 父亲的, 父系的, 似父亲的, 得自父亲的, 家长式统治的;父系的, 父亲的

examples.en: He took two weeks of paternal leave when his daughter was born.
examples.zh: 女儿出生时他休了两周陪产假。

meaning: vt. 改编成戏剧, 编写剧本;vi. 戏剧化

examples.en: The studio plans to dramatize the rescue in a television series.
examples.zh: 制片公司计划把这次救援改编成电视剧。

meaning: vt. 镇压, 抑制, 压制;vi. 压制

examples.en: Many survivors spent decades trying to repress memories of the disaster.
examples.zh: 许多幸存者花了几十年努力压抑灾难的记忆。

meaning: n. 全景, 全貌, 概论, 范围

examples.en: From the summit, hikers enjoy a panorama of forests, lakes, and villages.
examples.zh: 从山顶远眺，徒步者可饱览森林、湖泊和村庄的全景。

meaning: n. 无用, 无益, 无价值

examples.en: The general finally understood the futility of continuing the hopeless campaign.
examples.zh: 将军终于明白继续这场无望战役是徒劳的。

meaning: a. 多余的, 过剩的

examples.en: The editor removed several superfluous paragraphs from the final draft.
examples.zh: 编辑从终稿中删去了几段多余的文字。

meaning: a. 单调的, 无变化的

examples.en: The interns found the data entry work monotonous and tiring.
examples.zh: 实习生们觉得数据录入工作单调乏味。

meaning: n. 贫血, 贫血症, 无活力;贫血

examples.en: Doctors prescribed iron supplements to treat her mild anemia.
examples.zh: 医生开了铁剂来治疗她的轻度贫血。

meaning: n. 审慎, 慎重, 精明, 节俭

examples.en: Financial prudence helped the family survive the long economic downturn.
examples.zh: 财务上的审慎帮助这个家庭度过了漫长的经济衰退。

meaning: a. 用铅版印的, 老一套的, 套用老调的, 千篇一律的, 已成陈规的

examples.en: The film was criticized for its lazy, stereotyped portrayals of immigrants.
examples.zh: 这部电影因对移民刻板、敷衍的刻画而受到批评。

examples.en: Media coverage seemed to obsess over the singer's private life.
examples.zh: 媒体报道似乎对歌手的私生活念念不忘。

meaning: a. 卓越的, 超凡的, 先验的

examples.en: The seminar explores transcendental themes in nineteenth century American literature.
examples.zh: 研讨课探讨十九世纪美国文学中的超验主题。

meaning: n. 曲折线条, Z字形道路;a. 之字形的, 曲折的, 锯齿形的

examples.en: The hikers followed a steep zigzag path up the mountain.
examples.zh: 徒步者沿着陡峭的之字形小路登山。

meaning: a. 气质的, 性格的, 易兴奋的

examples.en: The old printing press is temperamental and often stops without warning.
examples.zh: 这台老印刷机喜怒无常，经常毫无征兆地停机。

examples.en: Small firms innovate quickly because they can test ideas without bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 小公司创新迅速，因为无需官僚程序就能验证想法。

meaning: n. 表演特技者, 杂技演员

examples.en: The acrobat balanced on a single rope high above the audience.
examples.zh: 杂技演员在观众头顶的一根绳索上保持平衡。

meaning: n. 充足, 充分的数量, 自负

examples.en: The report questions the sufficiency of current funding for rural schools.
examples.zh: 报告质疑当前农村学校经费是否充足。

meaning: n. 不变的东西, 常数;a. 不变的, 常数的

examples.en: Her invariable answer to late emails is a polite reminder.
examples.zh: 对于迟复的邮件，她总是一成不变地礼貌提醒。

meaning: n. 精湛技巧, 对古董等的爱好

examples.en: Audiences marveled at the violinist's effortless virtuosity throughout the evening.
examples.zh: 整晚观众都惊叹于小提琴家游刃有余的精湛技艺。

meaning: n. 工具主义者；乐器演奏家

examples.en: Every instrumentalist in the chamber group also teaches at the conservatory.
examples.zh: 室内乐团的每位器乐演奏家都在音乐学院任教。

examples.en: Walking upright on two feet is called bipedal locomotion.
examples.zh: 用双脚直立行走称为两足运动。

meaning: n. 系谱学者, 系谱专家

examples.en: A genealogist traced the family's roots back to the seventeenth century.
examples.zh: 一位系谱学家将这个家族的渊源追溯到了十七世纪。

meaning: vt. 虐待, 滥用;粗暴对待, 虐待, 乱用

examples.en: Farmers who maltreat their animals can now face heavy fines.
examples.zh: 虐待牲畜的农场主现在可能面临高额罚款。

examples.en: The trust was set up to administrate funds for local scholarships.
examples.zh: 设立该信托是为了管理当地奖学金基金。

examples.en: She waved goodby from the platform as the train pulled away.
examples.zh: 火车开动时，她在站台上挥手告别。

meaning: n. 回顾, 追忆, 反省;追想, 回忆

examples.en: In quiet retrospection, the author realized how much the city had changed.
examples.zh: 静静回想之际，作者意识到这座城市变化之大。

examples.en: A passerby used a fire extinguisher to control the flames.
examples.zh: 一位路人用灭火器控制了火势。

meaning: a. 不节俭的, 浪费的, 无用的

examples.en: His thriftless spending habits left the family with heavy debts.
examples.zh: 他挥霍无度的消费习惯使家庭负债累累。

meaning: a. 关心的, 有关的, 参与的, 担心的

examples.en: Concerned parents asked the school to explain its safety procedures.
examples.zh: 忧心忡忡的家长要求学校说明其安全规程。

meaning: n. 防卫, 防卫物;防御

examples.en: The lawyer built a strong defense around the missing timeline evidence.
examples.zh: 律师围绕缺失的时间线证据构建了有力的辩护。

meaning: n. 民主人士, 民主主义者, 民主党党员;民主党

examples.en: As a committed democrat, he insisted that every vote be counted publicly.
examples.zh: 作为坚定的民主主义者，他坚持每一票都要公开清点。

meaning: a. 难懂的, 复杂的, 不易懂的, 卷入...之中的, 累及..., 与...有关, 被纠缠的;包含, 涉及

examples.en: Parents involved in the project helped redesign the school library.
examples.zh: 参与该项目的家长帮助重新设计了学校图书馆。

meaning: a. 地方的, 地域性的;区的, 部位的

examples.en: The drought pushed regional food prices to their highest level in years.
examples.zh: 干旱使地区食品价格涨至多年来的最高点。

meaning: vt. 掠夺, 使苦恼, 强使前行, 折磨, 骚扰

examples.en: Paparazzi continued to harry the actress outside the courthouse.
examples.zh: 狗仔队在法院外不断纠缠这位女演员。

meaning: a. 国会的, 议会的, 议会制度的

examples.en: The bill faces a difficult parliamentary debate before it becomes law.
examples.zh: 该法案成为法律前还要经历艰难的议会辩论。

meaning: a. 会议的, 议会的, 国会的;代表大会的, 大会的, 议会的

examples.en: A congressional committee is investigating the misuse of federal funds.
examples.zh: 一个国会委员会正在调查联邦资金的滥用问题。

meaning: a. 固定的, 不变的;固定的, 确定的, 不变的

examples.en: The museum keeps fixed opening hours throughout the entire year.
examples.zh: 博物馆全年保持固定的开放时间。

meaning: n. 意识, 认识;识别, 议定, 明白

examples.en: The campaign raised public awareness of the dangers of drunk driving.
examples.zh: 这场活动提高了公众对酒驾危险的认识。

meaning: a. 记录的, 记录用的;n. 录音

examples.en: The band released a live recording of its sold out concert.
examples.zh: 乐队发行了座无虚席演唱会的现场录音。

meaning: a. 管理的, 行政的;行政的, 管理的, 遗产管理的

examples.en: She handled the administrative side of the lab while others ran experiments.
examples.zh: 她负责实验室的行政事务，其他人做实验。

meaning: n. 管理人, 行政官;遗产管理人员

examples.en: The hospital administrator cut costs without reducing the quality of care.
examples.zh: 医院管理者在不降低护理质量的前提下削减了成本。

meaning: n. 示范, 实证;示教, 实物教授

examples.en: Thousands joined a peaceful demonstration against the proposed fuel tax.
examples.zh: 数千人参加了反对燃油税提案的和平示威。

meaning: n. 合作, 协力, 配合;合作

examples.en: International cooperation proved essential during the global health emergency.
examples.zh: 全球卫生危机期间，国际合作被证明至关重要。

meaning: a. 宪法的, 立宪的, 体质的;全身的; 体质的

examples.en: The court must decide whether the new law is constitutional.
examples.zh: 法院必须裁定新法律是否符合宪法。

meaning: n. 视野范围, 知识范围, 见地

examples.en: Quantum physics remains beyond the ken of most ordinary readers.
examples.zh: 量子物理学仍超出大多数普通读者的理解范围。

meaning: adv. 非常地, 很, 颇

examples.en: Housing costs have risen considerably faster than wages over the decade.
examples.zh: 十年来住房成本的上涨速度远超工资。

meaning: n. 班, 小队, 小集团;vt. 编成班

examples.en: The rescue squad worked through the night searching for missing hikers.
examples.zh: 救援队彻夜搜寻失踪的徒步者。

meaning: n. 创立者, 建立者;vt. 使沉没, 使摔倒, 弄跛, 浸水, 破坏

examples.en: The company's founder started the business in a small garage.
examples.zh: 公司创始人在一个小车库里创办了这家企业。

meaning: n. 起立, 持续, 身分;a. 立着的, 不动的, 经常的, 持续的

examples.en: The committee invited professors of international standing to review the program.
examples.zh: 委员会邀请具有国际声望的教授来评审该项目。

meaning: a. 失业的, 未被利用的;没有被雇用的, 失业的, 没有被利用的

examples.en: The program offers training courses for unemployed workers in the region.
examples.zh: 该项目为该地区的失业工人提供培训课程。

meaning: a. 防卫的, 防备用的, 自卫的;n. 守势, 防卫姿势, 防卫物

examples.en: The minister grew defensive when reporters questioned the project's rising costs.
examples.zh: 当记者质疑项目成本上升时，部长变得急于辩解。

meaning: a. 老的, 陈的, 有...岁的;老化的; 老化了的; 陈化的; 陈化了的

examples.en: The survey focused on residents aged between sixty and seventy.
examples.zh: 调查对象为六十至七十岁的居民。

meaning: a. 有资格的；给与名称的

examples.en: Full-time students are entitled to a discount on monthly passes.
examples.zh: 全日制学生有权享受月票折扣。

meaning: a. 前进的, 进行的, 不间断的;n. 前进, 发展

examples.en: Negotiations are ongoing between the union and the hospital management.
examples.zh: 工会与医院管理层的谈判仍在进行中。

meaning: n. 顾问, 参事, 法律顾问

examples.en: The school counselor helps students plan their course schedules.
examples.zh: 学校辅导员帮助学生规划课程安排。

meaning: a. 确信的, 深信的

examples.en: The jury became convinced of the defendant's innocence after new evidence emerged.
examples.zh: 新证据出现后，陪审团相信被告是无辜的。

meaning: n. 生还者, 幸存者;生还者, 生存者, 辛存者

examples.en: Each survivor of the earthquake received emergency shelter and medical care.
examples.zh: 每位地震幸存者都获得了应急住所和医疗护理。

meaning: n. 会计学, 帐单, 清帐;帐户处理, 记帐

examples.en: She studied accounting before joining the family's restaurant business.
examples.zh: 她学会计后加入了家里的餐饮生意。

meaning: n. 提款, 撤退, 退回, 撤消, 退隐, 戒毒过程;戒除, 脱瘾

examples.en: The bank charges a fee for each cash withdrawal abroad.
examples.zh: 银行对每次境外取现收取手续费。

meaning: a. 富有经验的, 老练的, 熟练的

examples.en: Experienced nurses guided the new staff through the emergency procedures.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的护士指导新员工熟悉急救流程。

meaning: n. 效力;有效性, 能行性

examples.en: Researchers compared the effectiveness of online and classroom teaching methods.
examples.zh: 研究人员比较了线上与课堂教学方法的效果。

meaning: n. 有把的大罐, 瓶状体, 投手, 摊贩

examples.en: The team's new pitcher won his first three games.
examples.zh: 球队的新投手赢下了前三场比赛。

examples.en: Hispanic families make up nearly a third of the neighborhood's population.
examples.zh: 西班牙裔家庭占该社区人口近三分之一。

meaning: a. 功能的;机能的, 功能的, 官能的

examples.en: The old mill was converted into functional office space last year.
examples.zh: 老磨坊去年被改造成了实用的办公空间。

meaning: n. 管理者, 监督者, 指导者, 视导员;管理程序

examples.en: Her supervisor praised the careful design of the new experiment.
examples.zh: 她的导师称赞了新实验的严谨设计。

meaning: n. 角斗场, 舞台, 场地;尿沉渣, 尿沙; 脑沙

examples.en: The debate transformed the town hall into a political arena.
examples.zh: 这场辩论使市政厅变成了政治竞技场。

meaning: n. 弹性, 适应性;灵活性; 适应性

examples.en: Remote work gives employees greater flexibility in managing family responsibilities.
examples.zh: 远程办公让员工在兼顾家庭责任方面拥有更大灵活性。

examples.en: In medieval villages, a wright repaired carts, wheels, and wooden tools.
examples.zh: 在中世纪村庄，工匠修理马车、车轮和木制工具。

meaning: n. 战士, 勇士, 武士, 鼓吹战争的人, 战斗, 尚武

examples.en: The museum displays the armor of a medieval Japanese warrior.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一位中世纪日本武士的盔甲。

meaning: n. 制图法, 制图学, 图解算法, 图形显示;图形; DOS外部命令:打印图形方式下的屏幕内容

examples.en: The presentation combined clear graphics with short, punchy explanations.
examples.zh: 演示将清晰的图表与简短有力的讲解结合在一起。

meaning: n. 沉思, 推测, 投机;投机交易, 买空卖空

examples.en: The report fueled speculation that the CEO would resign within months.
examples.zh: 这份报告引发了关于首席执行官将在数月内辞职的猜测。

meaning: n. 隔绝, 孤立, 隔离;分离; 生物分离

examples.en: Prolonged isolation can seriously affect both mood and physical health.
examples.zh: 长期孤立会严重影响情绪和身体健康。

meaning: a. 本土的, 国产的, 固有的;原产的, 本土的

examples.en: The exhibit celebrates indigenous art from across the Pacific region.
examples.zh: 该展览致敬太平洋地区的原住民艺术。

meaning: n. 修辞, 修辞学, 雄辩(术)

examples.en: The speech was long on rhetoric but short on concrete plans.
examples.zh: 这篇演讲辞藻华丽，却缺乏具体计划。

meaning: n. 腐败, 堕落, 贪污;论误

examples.en: The new agency was created to fight corruption in public contracts.
examples.zh: 成立新机构是为了打击公共合同中的腐败。

meaning: adv. 地方性地, 局部性地, 在当地

examples.en: The restaurant sources most of its vegetables locally to guarantee freshness.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅的大部分蔬菜都在本地采购以保证新鲜。

meaning: n. 捐赠人;给体; 供体

examples.en: An anonymous donor paid for the school's new science laboratory.
examples.zh: 一位匿名捐助者出资修建了学校的新科学实验室。

meaning: n. 审计员, 听者, 旁听生;审计(查帐)员, 审计师, 会计检查员

examples.en: The external auditor questioned several entries in last year's accounts.
examples.zh: 外部审计员对去年账目中的若干条目提出质疑。

meaning: a. 受控制的, 统制的, 调整的;规则的

examples.en: The airline violated several regulatory requirements during the busy summer season.
examples.zh: 该航空公司在繁忙的暑运期间违反了多项监管要求。

meaning: n. 犯罪地点, 审判地, 发生地点

examples.en: The organizers changed the venue because of the sudden storm warning.
examples.zh: 由于突如其来的风暴警报，主办方更换了场地。

examples.en: The professor questioned the relevance of the theory to modern markets.
examples.zh: 教授质疑该理论与现代市场的相关性。

meaning: a. 燃烧的, 象燃烧一样的;n. 烧, 燃烧

examples.en: The burning question is whether the city can afford the project.
examples.zh: 迫在眉睫的问题是该市能否负担这个项目。

meaning: n. 排除, 除外, 逐出;排除, 除外, 分离术

examples.en: Critics argued that the policy led to the exclusion of smaller parties.
examples.zh: 批评者认为该政策导致小党派被排除在外。

meaning: a. 部落的, 宗族的

examples.en: The museum documents the tribal cultures of the northern river valleys.
examples.zh: 博物馆记录了北方河谷地区的部落文化。

meaning: a. 综合的, 完整的, 互相协调的;成为整体的, 综合的, 统筹的

examples.en: The city built an integrated network of buses, trams, and trains.
examples.zh: 该市建成了整合公交、有轨电车和火车的综合网络。

meaning: a. 意识形态的, 空想的;思想的, 思想上的, 意识形态的

examples.en: The two parties remain divided by deep ideological differences on welfare policy.
examples.zh: 两党在福利政策上仍存在深刻的意识形态分歧。

examples.en: The course examines group dynamics in modern workplace settings.
examples.zh: 这门课程考察现代职场中的群体动力。

meaning: a. 延续的, 伸出的, 竭尽全力的, 广大的, 扩大范围的;展期的, 延期的, 延长的

examples.en: The committee granted an extended deadline for submitting the final report.
examples.zh: 委员会准许延长提交最终报告的期限。

meaning: a. 孤立的, 孤零零的;隔离的, 绝缘的

examples.en: Some isolated villages still lack reliable electricity and internet access.
examples.zh: 一些偏远孤立的村庄仍然缺乏稳定的电力和网络。

examples.en: New employees are paired with a buddy during their first month.
examples.zh: 新员工入职第一个月会配一名伙伴协助熟悉工作。

meaning: a. 反对的, 敌对的, 对抗的, 相对的;反对的, 相反的, 对立的

examples.en: Local farmers remained opposed to the planned expansion of the airport.
examples.zh: 当地农民仍反对机场的扩建计划。

meaning: a. 古巴的, 古巴人的;n. 古巴人

examples.en: Cuban musicians blended Spanish guitar traditions with African rhythms.
examples.zh: 古巴音乐家将西班牙吉他传统与非洲节奏融为一体。

meaning: n. 触地, 触地得分, 着地

examples.en: The stadium erupted when the quarterback scored the winning touchdown.
examples.zh: 四分卫达阵得分锁定胜局时，全场沸腾了。

meaning: adv. 活跃地, 积极地

examples.en: The council is actively recruiting engineers for the new water project.
examples.zh: 市政府正在为新水利项目积极招募工程师。

meaning: a. 有资格的;合格的, 有条件的, 有限制的

examples.en: Only qualified electricians should repair problems in the main power panel.
examples.zh: 只有持证电工才应维修主配电箱的故障。

meaning: n. 画像, 肖像, 偶像, 图标, 像标;像标, 图标

examples.en: The little coffee shop became a cultural icon in the city.
examples.zh: 这家小咖啡馆成了这座城市的文化标志。

meaning: n. 提醒的人, 暗示;催单

examples.en: The sticky note on the door served as a daily reminder.
examples.zh: 门上的便利贴成了每天的提醒。

meaning: n. 监禁, 下狱, 坐牢;监禁, 徒刑, 拘禁

examples.en: He faced up to ten years of imprisonment for the fraud.
examples.zh: 他因欺诈罪面临最高十年的监禁。

meaning: n. 荷尔蒙;激素(旧称荷尔蒙)

examples.en: Stress causes the body to release a hormone called cortisol.
examples.zh: 压力会使身体释放一种叫皮质醇的激素。

examples.en: The architects envision a car-free district with wide cycling lanes.
examples.zh: 建筑师们设想一个无汽车、设有宽阔自行车道的街区。

examples.en: Investing all your savings in one startup is extremely risky.
examples.zh: 把全部积蓄投进一家初创公司风险极大。

examples.en: Science fiction is her favorite genre, especially stories about Mars.
examples.zh: 科幻是她最喜欢的类型，尤其是关于火星的故事。

meaning: a. 不恰当的, 无关系的, 不相干的;无关的, 不相干的, 离题的

examples.en: The judge ruled the celebrity's private life irrelevant to the case.
examples.zh: 法官裁定这位名人的私生活与案件无关。

meaning: n. 大块, 矮胖的人(或物);定样

examples.en: The project ate a huge chunk of the department's annual budget.
examples.zh: 该项目耗掉了部门年度预算的一大块。

meaning: n. 呼吸, 瞬间, 微风;a. 呼吸的, 逼真的

examples.en: The instructor taught simple breathing exercises to calm anxious passengers.
examples.zh: 教练教授简单的呼吸练习来安抚焦虑的乘客。

meaning: n. 移民, 移往, 移动;迁移

examples.en: Climate change has shifted the migration patterns of many birds.
examples.zh: 气候变化改变了许多鸟类的迁徙模式。

meaning: n. 新闻业, 报章杂志;报刊, 新闻业, 新闻出版

examples.en: She chose journalism because she wanted to explain science to the public.
examples.zh: 她选择新闻行业，因为想向公众解释科学。

meaning: adv. 想象上, 看上去像, 被认为是, 恐怕, 按照推测

examples.en: The bridge was supposedly built in a single year, which amazes engineers.
examples.zh: 据说这座桥一年就建成，令工程师们惊叹。

meaning: n. 条理, 斑纹, 倾向;vt. 加条纹

examples.en: The team finally ended its long losing streak this weekend.
examples.zh: 球队终于在本周末结束了漫长的连败。

meaning: n. 专业, 专长, 特产, 特制品, 特性, 特点;a. 专门的, 独立的

examples.en: Grilled fish is the specialty of this small coastal restaurant.
examples.zh: 烤鱼是这家海滨小餐厅的招牌菜。

meaning: n. (绳索的)股, 绳, 串, 海滨, 河岸;vi. 搁浅

examples.en: Each strand of silk is thinner than a human hair.
examples.zh: 每根蚕丝都比人的头发还细。

meaning: n. 碎片, 残骸;碎屑

examples.en: Rescue teams searched the debris for survivors through the night.
examples.zh: 救援队彻夜在废墟中搜寻幸存者。

examples.en: Good notes ensure continuity when staff changes happen mid-project.
examples.zh: 完善的记录可确保项目中途换人时的连续性。

meaning: n. 评论员, 实况广播员, 注释者, 时事评论员

examples.en: The sports commentator apologized for his remarks during the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 体育评论员为直播中的言论道歉。

examples.en: The novelist is remembered as a pioneering feminist of her generation.
examples.zh: 这位小说家被铭记为她那一代的女权运动先驱。

examples.en: Good health is a blessing that many people take for granted.
examples.zh: 健康是许多人视作理所当然的福气。

meaning: vt. 制定法律, 扮演, 颁布;法令, 法规, 条例

examples.en: Parliament voted to enact the new consumer protection law.
examples.zh: 议会投票制定了新的消费者保护法。

meaning: n. 租费, 租金收入;a. 租赁的, 收取租金的

examples.en: The rental market cooled after the government limited short-term listings.
examples.zh: 政府限制短租房源后，租赁市场降温了。

meaning: a. 不同的, 杂色的, 各式各样的;不同的, 种种的, 变化的

examples.en: The festival offers a varied program of films and live music.
examples.zh: 艺术节提供了电影与现场音乐兼备的丰富节目。

meaning: n. 发射, 计划, 突出部分, 设计, 推测;投影

examples.en: The latest projection shows the population doubling by 2050.
examples.zh: 最新预测显示人口将在2050年前翻倍。

meaning: n. 遗传, 遗产;遗传

examples.en: She used part of her inheritance to open a small bookshop.
examples.zh: 她用一部分遗产开了一家小书店。

meaning: a. 引入歧途的, 使人误解的, 骗人的;误写姓名的, 误称的, 令人误解的

examples.en: The regulator fined the firm for misleading advertisements about investment returns.
examples.zh: 监管机构因误导性的投资收益广告对该公司处以罚款。

meaning: a. 不适当的, 不相称的

examples.en: Wearing casual clothes to a formal interview is clearly inappropriate.
examples.zh: 穿便装参加正式面试显然不合适。

meaning: n. 采石场, 方形石, 猎物, 被追求物, 来源;vt. 挖出, 努力挖掘

examples.en: The old quarry now fills with rainwater and attracts wild birds.
examples.zh: 老采石场如今积满雨水，吸引了野生鸟类。

meaning: n. 福音, 信仰, 真理

examples.en: The choir performed a stirring gospel arrangement at the weekend concert.
examples.zh: 合唱团在周末音乐会上演唱了动人的福音歌曲改编曲。

meaning: n. 承认, 坦白, 招供;自白, 招供, 自认有罪

examples.en: The court threw out the confession because it was obtained illegally.
examples.zh: 法院以非法获取为由排除了这份供词。

meaning: a. 毁灭性的, (非正式)很好的, 引人注目的

examples.en: The typhoon had a devastating effect on the coastal fishing industry.
examples.zh: 台风对沿海渔业造成了毁灭性影响。

meaning: n. 疏忽, 粗心大意, 忽视;疏忽, 过失

examples.en: The hospital admitted negligence in failing to diagnose the infection early.
examples.zh: 医院承认未能及早诊断出感染属于过失。

meaning: n. 依赖, 依存, 信赖;依赖(如对药物的依赖,即瘾或癖), 从属, 偏利共生

examples.en: The country aims to reduce its dependence on imported energy.
examples.zh: 该国旨在降低对进口能源的依赖。

meaning: n. 控告, 指控, 指责;控告, 起诉, 告发

examples.en: The newspaper withdrew the accusation after the minister threatened legal action.
examples.zh: 部长威胁采取法律行动后，报社撤回了指控。

meaning: n. 解除, 免除, 免税;免检

examples.en: Small charities enjoy an exemption from the new reporting requirements.
examples.zh: 小型慈善机构可免于新的申报要求。

meaning: n. 薄膜, 膜, 羊皮纸;膜; 隔膜

examples.en: Each cell is surrounded by a thin membrane that controls intake.
examples.zh: 每个细胞都被一层控制物质进出的薄膜包围。

meaning: a. 公平的, 平衡的;平衡的, 对称的, 均衡的

examples.en: A balanced report should include voices from every side of the dispute.
examples.zh: 平衡的报道应包含争议各方的声音。

meaning: n. 主题, 基调, 动机, 基本图案;主旨, 主题, 动机

examples.en: The sea is a recurring motif throughout the poet's early work.
examples.zh: 大海是这位诗人早期作品中反复出现的主题。

meaning: n. 发声, 言辞, 表达, 说话的方式, 死;发言, 言语, 语调

examples.en: Every public utterance by the central bank is analyzed by traders.
examples.zh: 交易员会仔细分析央行的每一次公开发言。

meaning: n. 促进者, 助长者;助催化剂

examples.en: The concert promoter promised refunds after the singer canceled the tour.
examples.zh: 歌手取消巡演后，演唱会主办方承诺退款。

meaning: n. 坚硬性, 黏稠度, 一致性;稠度; 一致性

examples.en: The chef checks the consistency of the sauce before serving.
examples.zh: 厨师上菜前会检查酱汁的浓稠度。

meaning: a. 相互作用的, 相互影响的;交互, 人机对话的

examples.en: The museum's interactive exhibits let children operate simple machines.
examples.zh: 博物馆的互动展项让孩子们可以操作简单的机械。

meaning: a. 冗长的, 漫长的

examples.en: The project was delayed by a lengthy environmental review process.
examples.zh: 漫长的环境评估流程拖延了项目进度。

meaning: a. 投入的, 深爱的

examples.en: Her devoted fans traveled across the country to attend every concert.
examples.zh: 忠实的歌迷跨越全国去听她的每一场演唱会。

meaning: a. 传说的, 传奇中说的, 传奇般的, 传说中的, 著名的

examples.en: The legendary jazz club has hosted musicians for nearly eighty years.
examples.zh: 这家传奇爵士俱乐部迎来送往音乐家已近八十年。

meaning: a. 双重的, 双的;n. 双数

examples.en: The tablet serves a dual purpose at work and at school.
examples.zh: 这台平板电脑在工作和学习中都有用途。

meaning: n. 不一致, 变化, 变异, 分歧, 不和;方差; 变种

examples.en: The budget variance was traced to unexpected increases in material costs.
examples.zh: 预算差异被追溯至材料成本的意外上涨。

meaning: a. 能养活的, 能生长发育的;有活力的, 有生机的

examples.en: Solar power is now a viable alternative to coal in many regions.
examples.zh: 在许多地区，太阳能已成为煤炭的可行替代方案。

meaning: n. 生物学家;生物学家

examples.en: The marine biologist studies how noise pollution affects whale communication.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家研究噪音污染如何影响鲸类交流。

meaning: n. 抗生素;a. 抗生的

examples.en: Doctors warn that overusing antibiotic drugs speeds up resistance.
examples.zh: 医生警告滥用抗生素会加速耐药性。

examples.en: His inability to delegate tasks left the team constantly behind schedule.
examples.zh: 他不会分配任务，导致团队总是落后于进度。

meaning: a. 有光泽的, 发光的, 辉煌的, 磨光的, 磨损的

examples.en: The floor was so shiny that it reflected the gallery lights.
examples.zh: 地板光亮得能映出画廊的灯光。

meaning: n. 复兴, 复活, 恢复精神, 苏醒;复苏, 回生, 精神重振

examples.en: The theater's revival of the classic musical drew full houses.
examples.zh: 剧院重排的经典音乐剧场场爆满。

meaning: n. 改造, 再建;改建, 改造, 翻造

examples.en: The reconstruction of the old bridge took nearly five years.
examples.zh: 老桥的重建花了近五年时间。

examples.en: The detective examined the corpse for clues about the time of death.
examples.zh: 侦探检查尸体以寻找死亡时间的线索。

meaning: n. (总称)文件;文件编制, 文档

examples.en: The inspector asked for documentation proving the building met safety codes.
examples.zh: 检查员要求提供证明建筑符合安全规范的文件。

meaning: a. 治愈的, 恢复健康的;修复, 恢复

examples.en: The healing process after surgery takes patience and steady rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 术后的康复过程需要耐心和持续的复健。

meaning: n. 废除, 废奴运动;禁止, 消失

examples.en: The museum traces the abolition of slavery through personal letters.
examples.zh: 博物馆通过私人信件追溯奴隶制的废除历程。

examples.en: The national debt approached one trillion dollars for the first time.
examples.zh: 国债首次接近一万亿美元。

meaning: n. 出现, 浮现, 发生

examples.en: Historians link the emergence of cities to early agricultural surpluses.
examples.zh: 历史学家将城市的出现与早期农业剩余联系起来。

meaning: n. 杀人, 杀人者;杀人, 杀人者

examples.en: The homicide rate in the city fell for the third straight year.
examples.zh: 该市凶杀率连续第三年下降。

meaning: a. 热情的, 热烈的, 易怒的, 热恋的

examples.en: She is a passionate advocate for cleaner rivers in the region.
examples.zh: 她是该地区河流清洁的热心倡导者。

meaning: n. 肖像, 比喻, 雕刻;成像

examples.en: The poet's imagery of winter captures the silence of the village.
examples.zh: 诗人冬日的意象捕捉到了村庄的寂静。

examples.en: Each enzyme in the digestive system breaks down a specific nutrient.
examples.zh: 消化系统中的每种酶分解特定的营养物质。

meaning: n. 兵工厂, 军械库;兵工厂

examples.en: Inspectors visited the arsenal to verify the destruction of old weapons.
examples.zh: 核查人员前往军械库核实旧武器的销毁情况。

meaning: n. 膜拜, 礼拜式, 祭仪, 一群信徒;迷信, 巫术

examples.en: The film about the space cult won an award at the festival.
examples.zh: 这部关于太空邪教的电影在电影节上获奖。

meaning: n. 疑问, 疑问号, 质问, 查询;v. 询问, 质问

examples.en: The librarian answered every query about the new borrowing rules.
examples.zh: 图书管理员解答了关于新借阅规定的每一个疑问。

examples.en: She acts as the liaison between the hospital and community groups.
examples.zh: 她担任医院与社区团体之间的联络人。

meaning: adv. 新, 新近, 精神饱满

examples.en: The bakery fills the street with the smell of freshly baked bread.
examples.zh: 面包店让整条街道弥漫着新烤面包的香气。

examples.en: She became a firm believer in exercise after recovering from illness.
examples.zh: 大病痊愈后，她成了运动的坚定信徒。

meaning: a. 孤单的, 孤立的, 单身的, 寂寞的

examples.en: A lone fisherman sat on the pier at first light.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，一位孤独的渔夫坐在码头上。

meaning: n. 国会议员, 众议院议员;国会议会

examples.en: The congressman promised to push for stricter rules on campaign spending.
examples.zh: 这位国会议员承诺推动更严格的竞选经费规则。

meaning: n. 愚蠢, 荒唐事, 讽刺剧

examples.en: Critics called the giant dam an expensive folly from the very beginning.
examples.zh: 批评者从一开始就称这座巨型大坝是代价高昂的愚蠢工程。

meaning: a. 地理(学)的, 地区(性)的

examples.en: The study explores the geographic distribution of rare plant species.
examples.zh: 该研究探讨珍稀植物物种的地理分布。

meaning: n. 监督人, 主管人, 主日学校校长;监督人, 主管人(部门)

examples.en: The school superintendent announced new safety measures for all district buses.
examples.zh: 学区总监宣布了针对所有校车的新安全措施。

examples.en: The first chapter gives a conceptual overview of the entire theory.
examples.zh: 第一章对整个理论作了概念性概述。

meaning: a. 令人恐惧的；引起突然惊恐的

examples.en: The speed of the spreading wildfire was frightening to the residents.
examples.zh: 野火蔓延的速度令居民感到恐惧。

meaning: a. 岩石的, 多石的, 像岩石的, 无情的, 摇动的, 摇晃的

examples.en: The hikers picked their way down the rocky slope in silence.
examples.zh: 徒步者们默默择路走下多石的斜坡。

meaning: a. 最后的, 终于的

examples.en: Both sides hoped for an eventual agreement after months of negotiation.
examples.zh: 经过数月谈判，双方都希望最终达成协议。

meaning: a. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的

examples.en: The magician's tricks seemed genuinely magical to the excited children.
examples.zh: 魔术师的戏法在兴奋的孩子们看来真的像魔法。

meaning: n. 融资, 理财, 筹集的资金;筹措资金, 理财

examples.en: The startup secured enough financing to build its first factory.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司获得了建造首座工厂的足够资金。

examples.en: Weekly team breakfasts have noticeably improved office morale this quarter.
examples.zh: 每周团队早餐明显改善了这个季度的办公室士气。

meaning: vt. 围绕, 完成, 包括, 包含, 环绕, 包围

examples.en: The new nature reserve will encompass wetlands, forests, and coastal dunes.
examples.zh: 新自然保护区将涵盖湿地、森林和海岸沙丘。

meaning: n. 氏族, 宗族, 集团;支

examples.en: The highland clan gathered each summer for games and storytelling.
examples.zh: 这个高地氏族每年夏天聚在一起举办竞赛和讲故事。

meaning: n. 港, 避难所, 安息所;vt. 安置...于港中, 庇护, 入港

examples.en: The quiet library became a haven for students during exams.
examples.zh: 安静的图书馆成了学生考试期间的避风港。

meaning: n. 忧郁, 暗处, 幽暗;vi. 变忧沉, 变黑暗

examples.en: Economic gloom deepened after the factory announced hundreds of layoffs.
examples.zh: 工厂宣布裁员数百人后，经济阴霾加剧。

examples.en: The movie's ending was so predictable that many viewers left early.
examples.zh: 电影结局太容易猜到，许多观众提前离场。

meaning: n. 残渣, 剩余, 余数;残基; 残渣; 残液; 釜液

examples.en: Scientists found chemical residue on the ancient pottery fragments.
examples.zh: 科学家在古代陶器残片上发现了化学残留物。

meaning: n. 扫除, 垃圾;a. 扫荡的, 彻底的, 广泛的

examples.en: The new government promised sweeping reforms to the welfare system.
examples.zh: 新政府承诺对福利制度进行大刀阔斧的改革。

meaning: n. 盔甲, 潜水服, 装甲;vt. 为...装甲

examples.en: The knight's armor is displayed beside his sword in the castle.
examples.zh: 骑士的盔甲与佩剑一起陈列在城堡里。

examples.en: The biologists studied cellular changes caused by the rare disorder.
examples.zh: 生物学家研究了这种罕见疾病引起的细胞变化。

meaning: n. 积聚, 累积, 积聚物;蓄积, 累积

examples.en: Years of accumulation turned the attic into a crowded storage room.
examples.zh: 多年的积攒让阁楼变成了拥挤的储藏室。

meaning: n. 支柱, 支持者, 倚靠人, 道具, 螺旋桨;vt. 支撑, 维持

examples.en: Stagehands used a metal pole to prop the scenery upright.
examples.zh: 舞台工作人员用金属杆把布景撑直。

meaning: a. 苍白的, 无血色的, 病态的, 暗淡的;v. (使)变苍白

examples.en: The patient gave the nurse a wan smile from the bed.
examples.zh: 病人躺在床上对护士虚弱地笑了笑。

meaning: a. 生殖的, 再生的, 复制的;生殖的, 复现的

examples.en: The chemicals may damage the reproductive systems of fish in the river.
examples.zh: 这些化学物质可能损害河中鱼类的生殖系统。

meaning: n. 圆锥体, 球果;vt. 使成锥形

examples.en: The pine drops a hard cone every time the wind picks up.
examples.zh: 每当起风，松树就会掉下一颗坚硬的松果。

examples.en: The report measures educational attainment across different regions and income groups.
examples.zh: 报告衡量不同地区和收入群体的教育成就。

meaning: a. 表示实在的, 有实质的, 独立存在的, 大量的, 重大的, 坚实的, 名词的;n. 名词性实词, 名词

examples.en: The talks produced little substantive progress beyond polite declarations.
examples.zh: 除了客套的宣言，会谈几乎没有实质性进展。

meaning: n. 血浆, 淋巴液, 原生质, 等离子体;等离体; 等离子体

examples.en: Donated plasma is used to treat patients with severe burns.
examples.zh: 捐献的血浆用于治疗严重烧伤患者。

meaning: n. 受体, 感觉器官;接受器; 受体

examples.en: The drug works by blocking a specific receptor on nerve cells.
examples.zh: 该药物通过阻断神经细胞上的特定受体起作用。

meaning: n. 分泌, 分泌物, 分泌液, 隐蔽;分泌; 分泌物

examples.en: The lab analyzed the secretion produced by the skin glands.
examples.zh: 实验室分析了皮肤腺体产生的分泌物。

examples.en: The postwar years brought rapid industrial growth to the northern cities.
examples.zh: 战后岁月给北方城市带来了快速的工业增长。

meaning: a. 消遣的, 娱乐的

examples.en: The city plans to turn the old rail line into recreational trails.
examples.zh: 市政府计划把旧铁路线改建成休闲步道。

meaning: a. 受过教育的, 有教养的

examples.en: An educated workforce attracts technology companies to the growing region.
examples.zh: 受过良好教育的劳动力吸引科技公司入驻这个快速发展的地区。

meaning: vi. 恢复, 复归, 回复, 还原;vt. 使回复原状, 使回转

examples.en: The village may revert to traditional farming if modern equipment fails.
examples.zh: 如果现代设备失效，村庄可能恢复传统耕作。

meaning: n. 法院, 郡政府所在地

examples.en: Reporters waited on the courthouse steps for the verdict.
examples.zh: 记者在法院台阶上等待判决结果。

meaning: v. 猛砍, 乱砍;n. 猛砍, 乱砍, 删减

examples.en: The company plans to slash prices before the holiday shopping season.
examples.zh: 公司计划在假日购物季前大幅降价。

meaning: vt. 制止, 吓住, 威慑

examples.en: Bright street lights and cameras deter crime in the busy district.
examples.zh: 明亮的路灯和摄像头震慑着繁华城区的犯罪。

meaning: n. 圣所(指教堂、寺院等), 耶路撒冷的神殿, 避难所;庇护所, 避难所, 教堂

examples.en: The island is a sanctuary for thousands of migrating seabirds.
examples.zh: 这座岛是数千只迁徙海鸟的庇护所。

examples.en: The tiny nation produced an astonishing number of world-class athletes.
examples.zh: 这个小国培养出了数量惊人的世界级运动员。

meaning: a. 谨慎的, 小心的, 机警的, 周到的, 唯恐的

examples.en: Investors remain wary of startups that cannot explain their business model.
examples.zh: 投资者对说不清商业模式的初创公司仍持谨慎态度。

meaning: a. 饱和的, 渗透的;饱和的

examples.en: The market for delivery apps is already saturated in major cities.
examples.zh: 大城市的外卖应用市场已经饱和。

meaning: a. 令人震惊的, 极坏的, 不正当的

examples.en: The audit revealed shocking gaps in the charity's financial controls.
examples.zh: 审计揭示了该慈善机构财务管控中令人震惊的漏洞。

meaning: a. 冲突的, 不一致的, 相矛盾的

examples.en: Shoppers received conflicting advice about which masks were most effective.
examples.zh: 购物者收到了关于哪种口罩最有效的相互矛盾的建议。

meaning: n. 所有者;所有人, 资本主, 业主

examples.en: The shop's proprietor greets regular customers by name every morning.
examples.zh: 店主每天早晨都会亲切地叫出老顾客的名字。

meaning: n. 不公平, 非正义的行为;不公正, 不公平, 权利侵害

examples.en: The novel describes the injustice faced by farm workers a century ago.
examples.zh: 小说描写了一个世纪前农场工人遭受的不公。

meaning: n. 剥夺, 剥夺官职, 免职;丧失, 剥夺, 缺乏

examples.en: Studies link sleep deprivation to poor memory and weakened concentration.
examples.zh: 研究将睡眠剥夺与记忆力下降和注意力减弱联系起来。

meaning: n. 同等, 协调;协调; 进程协调

examples.en: The flood response required careful coordination between police, medics, and volunteers.
examples.zh: 抗洪救灾需要警方、医务人员和志愿者之间的细致协调。

meaning: a. 暴虐的, 极无礼的, 可恶的

examples.en: Critics called the executive's bonus outrageous given the company's falling profits.
examples.zh: 鉴于公司利润下滑，批评者称高管奖金高得离谱。

meaning: n. 模子, 模型, 霉;v. 形成, 塑造, 发霉

examples.en: Black mold spread across the basement walls after the flooding.
examples.zh: 洪水过后，黑色霉菌蔓延到地下室墙面。

meaning: n. 斜坡, 坡道, 敲诈;vi. 狂跳乱撞, 乱冲, 敲诈, 蔓延

examples.en: A new wheelchair ramp makes the library entrance accessible to everyone.
examples.zh: 新建的轮椅坡道让图书馆入口对所有人开放。

meaning: n. 写实主义, 现实, 实在论;现实主义

examples.en: Critics praised the film's gritty realism and restrained emotional power.
examples.zh: 影评人称赞影片粗粝的现实主义和克制的情感力量。

meaning: n. 继续, 续集, 补编;连续

examples.en: The grant ensures the continuation of the free lunch program.
examples.zh: 这笔拨款保证了免费午餐项目的延续。

meaning: n. 平板, 厚片;vt. 切成厚板, 以平板盖上

examples.en: Workers lifted the concrete slab with a small crane.
examples.zh: 工人们用小型吊车吊起了混凝土板。

meaning: n. 大圆石;圆石, 漂石

examples.en: A massive boulder blocked the mountain road after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，一块巨石挡住了山路。

meaning: n. 胜利者;a. 胜利的

examples.en: The victor of the chess tournament was only fourteen years old.
examples.zh: 国际象棋锦标赛的冠军年仅十四岁。

meaning: a. 持续的, 持久不变的, 持久的, 不懈的;持续的

examples.en: Sustained investment in railways transformed travel across the entire country.
examples.zh: 对铁路的持续投资改变了全国的旅行方式。

meaning: a. 季节的, 依照季节的, 周期性的;季节性的, 季节的

examples.en: The resort hires seasonal staff during the busy ski months.
examples.zh: 度假村在繁忙的滑雪月份雇用季节性员工。

meaning: a. 致命的;n. 致死因子

examples.en: Even small amounts of the plant are lethal to grazing animals.
examples.zh: 这种植物即使少量也足以使食草动物致命。

meaning: n. 暴跌, 垂头弯腰的姿态;vi. 猛然掉落, 陷入, 衰落(经济等)

examples.en: The housing market entered a deep slump after interest rates rose.
examples.zh: 加息之后，房地产市场陷入深度低迷。

meaning: n. 吸引, 姻亲关系, 类同;亲合力; 亲合能; 亲合势; 近似; 类似

examples.en: She felt an immediate affinity with the city and its people.
examples.zh: 她对这座城市和这里的人产生了亲近感。

meaning: a. 被抛弃的, 无约束的, 恣意放荡的

examples.en: Vandals had stripped the abandoned factory of its copper wiring.
examples.zh: 破坏者把废弃工厂里的铜线都拆走了。

meaning: n. 预期, 预料;提前出现(如遗传病)

examples.en: The children could hardly sleep in anticipation of the morning train ride.
examples.zh: 孩子们期待着早晨的火车之旅，几乎睡不着。

examples.en: Losing your work because of a sudden power cut is deeply frustrating.
examples.zh: 因突然断电而丢失工作成果，实在令人沮丧。

meaning: vt. 揭开, 揭幕, 除去...的面纱;vi. 显露, 除去面纱

examples.en: The city will unveil a statue of the poet next spring.
examples.zh: 市政府将于明年春天为这位诗人揭幕一座雕像。

meaning: vt. 授予权力, 允许, 使能够;授权, 准许, 转委

examples.en: The training program aims to empower women in rural communities.
examples.zh: 该培训项目旨在赋能农村地区的女性。

examples.en: Fishermen haul lobster traps from the cold waters each dawn.
examples.zh: 渔民每天黎明从冰冷的海水中拉起龙虾笼。

meaning: a. 永久的, 永恒的, 持久的;n. 厚实斜纹织物

examples.en: The volunteer trip left a lasting impression on the young students.
examples.zh: 志愿者之旅给年轻学生们留下了持久的印象。

meaning: n. 党羽, 虔诚信徒, 同党, 游击队员;a. 党派的, 偏袒的, 效忠的, 献身的, 盲目推崇的

examples.en: The report was attacked as partisan by both major parties.
examples.zh: 这份报告被两大政党指责带有党派色彩。

meaning: a. 限制的, 约束的, 限定的;n. 限制词

examples.en: The restrictive visa rules discourage foreign researchers from attending the conference.
examples.zh: 严苛的签证规定打消了外国研究人员参会的意愿。

meaning: a. 考古学的, 考古学上的

examples.en: Builders halted construction after discovering an archaeological site beneath the parking lot.
examples.zh: 在停车场下发现考古遗址后，施工随即停止。

meaning: n. 蹲伏, 蜷缩;vi. 蹲下, 蜷着, 缩着

examples.en: The photographers crouch behind the fence to capture the shy birds.
examples.zh: 摄影师们蹲在栅栏后拍摄胆怯的鸟类。

meaning: a. 自制的, 国产的

examples.en: Neighbors shared homemade bread and soup with the new family.
examples.zh: 邻居们与新搬来的家庭分享自制面包和汤。

meaning: n. 胚胎, 胎儿, 胚芽;胚, 胚胎

examples.en: The lab studies how an embryo develops during its first days.
examples.zh: 实验室研究胚胎最初几天的发育过程。

meaning: n. 功效, 效力;效能, 功效, 效验

examples.en: Researchers tested the efficacy of the new vaccine in older adults.
examples.zh: 研究人员测试了新疫苗对老年人的效力。

meaning: a. 有力的, 有说服力的, 有效的;有力的, 有性交能力的

examples.en: Even a potent medicine can fail if patients skip doses.
examples.zh: 即使药效强劲的药物，漏服剂量也会失效。

meaning: n. 兽穴, 洞穴;匪巢, 贼窝

examples.en: The hunters tracked the fox back to its den near the river.
examples.zh: 猎人们把狐狸追踪到河边它的洞穴。

meaning: n. 调节, 条件作用, 整修;调节; 调整

examples.en: Athletes use physical conditioning to prepare their bodies for long seasons.
examples.zh: 运动员通过体能训练让身体为漫长赛季做准备。

meaning: a. 学者派头的, 学者风度的, 有学问的, 博学的, 好学的

examples.en: Her scholarly article on trade routes changed the field's thinking.
examples.zh: 她那篇关于商路的学术文章改变了学界的看法。

meaning: n. 咯咯的笑声, 轻笑;vi. 咯咯的笑, 咕咕叫

examples.en: The old professor would chuckle softly at his own jokes.
examples.zh: 老教授讲完自己的笑话总会轻声一笑。

meaning: a. 标准化的；标准的；定型的

examples.en: All applicants complete a standardized test before the interview stage.
examples.zh: 所有申请人在面试前都要完成标准化测试。

meaning: a. 相同的, 协调的;匹配, 对比

examples.en: The internship includes a matching grant for every dollar students raise.
examples.zh: 实习项目为学生筹集的每一美元提供配套资助。

meaning: a. 虚构的, 编造的, 小说式的;拟制的, 假定的, 虚构的

examples.en: The novel is set in a fictional town on the northern coast.
examples.zh: 这部小说以北方海岸一座虚构小镇为背景。

meaning: a. 饮食的;n. 规定食物

examples.en: Doctors advised him to change his dietary habits before the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生建议他在手术前改变饮食习惯。

meaning: n. 坚持, 坚决主张

examples.en: At her insistence, the meeting started exactly on time.
examples.zh: 在她的坚持下，会议准时开始。

examples.en: Oddly, the busiest shops closed earliest on the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是，假日周末最热闹的商店打烊最早。

meaning: n. 占有者, 居住者, 占用者

examples.en: The previous occupant of the office left behind boxes of files.
examples.zh: 办公室的前任使用者留下了一箱箱文件。

examples.en: The chain is expanding into smaller cities where rents stay affordable.
examples.zh: 这家连锁品牌正扩张到租金仍可负担的较小城市。

meaning: vi. 航行;vt. 航行于, 驾驶, 操纵, 使通过

examples.en: Students must navigate a complex system of course requirements and deadlines.
examples.zh: 学生必须应对课程要求和截止日期构成的复杂体系。

meaning: n. 困苦, 不适;不舒适, 不舒, 烦闷, 不快活

examples.en: Passengers reported mild discomfort during the plane's steep descent.
examples.zh: 乘客反映飞机陡峭下降时有轻微不适。

examples.en: Yoga classes help people become aware of their bodily tensions.
examples.zh: 瑜伽课帮助人们觉察自己身体的紧张。

meaning: n. 便利设施, 适意, 礼仪;舒适, 方便, 优雅

examples.en: The hotel's rooftop pool is its most popular amenity in summer.
examples.zh: 屋顶泳池是这家酒店夏季最受欢迎的设施。

meaning: n. 拨用, 挪用, 拨款;拨款, 挪用

examples.en: The senate approved the appropriation for rebuilding the storm-damaged bridges.
examples.zh: 参议院批准了重建风暴损毁桥梁的拨款。

meaning: n. 停车场, 车站, 贮藏所, 仓库;仓库, 贮存, 积存

examples.en: The buses return to the depot for cleaning after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜过后，公交车返回车库进行清洗。

meaning: n. 路径, 途径;路径, 道

examples.en: A narrow pathway leads from the cottage down to the shore.
examples.zh: 一条窄径从小屋一直通向海边。

meaning: n. 毂, 木片, 中心;插座; 插孔; 集线器, 集中器, 连接器, 中继站

examples.en: The airport has become a major hub for flights across the continent.
examples.zh: 这座机场已成为横跨大陆航班的主要枢纽。

meaning: a. 对面的, 反对的, 相反的, 相对的

examples.en: The two opposing armies faced each other across the frozen river.
examples.zh: 对峙的两军隔着冰封的河流相望。

meaning: n. 刺激, 激励, 鼓舞;兴奋, 刺激

examples.en: Babies need varied stimulation for healthy brain development.
examples.zh: 婴儿需要多样化的刺激以促进大脑健康发育。

meaning: n. 收缩, 缩写式, 害病;收缩; 挛缩; 牙弓内缩

examples.en: The contraction of the muscle can be measured with special sensors.
examples.zh: 肌肉的收缩可用特殊传感器测量。

meaning: a. 事实的, 实际的;事实的, 与事实有关的, 实际的

examples.en: A good documentary sticks to factual reporting rather than drama.
examples.zh: 优秀的纪录片坚持事实报道而非戏剧化。

meaning: n. 莴苣, 生菜, 纸币;莴苣

examples.en: She grows lettuce and herbs in a small greenhouse.
examples.zh: 她在小温室里种植生菜和香草。

meaning: vt. 符号化, 用符号表现;vi. 采用象征, 使用符号

examples.en: The two crossed keys symbolize the city's long trading history.
examples.zh: 两把交叉的钥匙象征着这座城市悠久的贸易史。

meaning: n. 前进, 连续, 级数;进行, 前进, 步态

examples.en: The workbook guides students through a steady progression of exercises.
examples.zh: 练习册引导学生循序渐进地完成一系列练习。

meaning: n. 泥瓦匠, 共济会会员;vt. 用砖瓦砌成

examples.en: A skilled mason rebuilt the stone wall in the traditional style.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的泥瓦匠以传统工艺重建了石墙。

meaning: n. 护送, 护卫;vt. 护航, 护送

examples.en: A convoy of trucks delivered food and medicine to the isolated towns.
examples.zh: 一支卡车车队把食品和药品送到偏远的城镇。

meaning: n. 限定词;a. 限定的, 决定性的

examples.en: Scientists still lack a definitive explanation for the strange lights.
examples.zh: 科学家对这些奇怪的光仍缺乏确定的解释。

meaning: n. 前进, 进步, 提升;徙前术

examples.en: She left the firm because advancement there depended on family connections.
examples.zh: 她离开了那家公司，因为晋升靠的是裙带关系。

meaning: n. 植物群;植物区系, 植物丛, 植物群, 菌丛

examples.en: The island's unique flora attracts botanists from around the world.
examples.zh: 岛上独特的植物群吸引着世界各地的植物学家。

examples.en: Mountain weather is famously unpredictable, so hikers carry extra supplies.
examples.zh: 山区天气出了名的多变，徒步者都会多带补给。

meaning: a. 僵硬的, 完全的, 刻板的, 明显的, 荒凉的, 结实的;adv. 突出地, 简直, 全然

examples.en: The report paints a stark picture of rural poverty.
examples.zh: 报告描绘了农村贫困的严峻图景。

meaning: a. 有利益的, 获利的, 合算的

examples.en: He turned down a lucrative offer to stay in public service.
examples.zh: 他拒绝了一份报酬丰厚的工作邀请，留在公共部门。

meaning: n. 令人着迷的事物, 入迷, 魅力

examples.en: Her fascination with ancient maps began during a childhood museum visit.
examples.zh: 她对古地图的痴迷始于童年的一次博物馆之旅。

meaning: n. 半身像, 胸部, 失败, 殴打;vt. 使爆裂, 使破产

examples.en: A marble bust of the philosopher guards the library entrance.
examples.zh: 图书馆入口处立着一尊哲学家的大理石半身像。

meaning: a. 振动的, 战栗的, 响亮的, 活跃的

examples.en: The night market gives the old district a vibrant new life.
examples.zh: 夜市给老城区带来了充满活力的新生。

meaning: n. 感性, 感觉, 情感;感觉性, 感受性; 感觉, 感觉能力

examples.en: The novel captures the artistic sensibility of the early twentieth century.
examples.zh: 小说捕捉到了二十世纪初的艺术感性。

meaning: n. 改革家, 改革运动者;转化炉; 转化器; 重整器; 重整炉

examples.en: The social reformer fought for cleaner streets in poor neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 这位社会改革者为贫困街区的街道清洁而奔走。

meaning: n. 教化, 培养, 耕作;培养

examples.en: Tea cultivation on the green hills supports thousands of local families.
examples.zh: 青山上的茶叶种植养活了数千户当地家庭。

meaning: a. 活生生的, 能活动的, 活泼的, 欢快的

examples.en: The children watched an animated film about life on the reef.
examples.zh: 孩子们看了一部关于珊瑚礁生活的动画电影。

meaning: a. 持久的, 忍耐的

examples.en: Her novels have an enduring appeal for readers of every generation.
examples.zh: 她的小说对每一代读者都有持久的吸引力。

examples.en: Her fieldwork in anthropology took her to remote mountain villages.
examples.zh: 人类学的田野调查把她带到了偏远的山村。

meaning: a. 治疗的, 有益于健康的;治疗的; 治疗学的

examples.en: Some patients find gardening gently therapeutic after a long illness.
examples.zh: 一些病人发现园艺对大病初愈有温和的疗愈作用。

meaning: a. 大慈大悲的, 宽厚的, 慈善的;慈善的, 慷慨的, 宽恕的

examples.en: The trust makes charitable donations to schools in poor districts.
examples.zh: 该基金会向贫困地区的学校进行慈善捐赠。

meaning: n. 赔偿, 保障, 补偿, 赦免, 保护;赔偿, 补偿, 赔偿金

examples.en: The contract includes an indemnity clause covering construction delays.
examples.zh: 合同包含一项赔偿条款，涵盖施工延误。

meaning: n. 神谕, 神谕处, 预言

examples.en: Ancient travelers crossed the mountains to consult the famous oracle.
examples.zh: 古代旅人翻山越岭去请教那位著名的神谕者。

meaning: a. 未决定的, 待决的, 行将发生的, 向外伸出的;prep. 在等待...之际, 直到...时为止, 在...期间, 在...过程中

examples.en: The final decision is pending until the environmental review is complete.
examples.zh: 在环境评估完成之前，最终决定仍悬而未决。

meaning: a. 模仿的, 摹拟的;n. 效颦者, 模仿者, 小丑, 仿制品

examples.en: Parrots mimic sounds they hear around the house all day.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉会整天模仿屋子里听到的声音。

meaning: a. 时间的, 暂时的, 现世的, 世俗的, 颞的, 太阳穴的;n. 世间万物, 教会财产

examples.en: The exhibition explores the temporal changes of the river landscape.
examples.zh: 展览探讨了河流景观随时间的变迁。

meaning: n. 崩, 薨, 死亡;vt. 让渡, 遗赠, 转让

examples.en: Historians still debate the reasons for the empire's sudden demise.
examples.zh: 历史学家仍在争论帝国突然衰亡的原因。

meaning: adv. 清楚地, 明白地, 简单地, 朴素地, 直率地, 坦白地

examples.en: The results plainly show that the program helped students read better.
examples.zh: 结果清楚地表明该项目帮助学生提高了阅读能力。

meaning: n. 火山口, 环行山, 弹坑;焊口; 火山石; 弧坑; 焰口

examples.en: Hikers climbed to the rim of the volcano's vast crater.
examples.zh: 徒步者登上了火山巨大火山口的边缘。

meaning: a. 回答的, 应答的, 易感应的

examples.en: The new app is far more responsive on older phones.
examples.zh: 新应用在旧手机上的响应速度快得多。

meaning: n. 潜伏, 潜行;vi. 暗藏, 潜伏, 埋伏

examples.en: Dangers lurk beneath the calm surface of the tropical bay.
examples.zh: 危险潜伏在热带海湾平静的水面之下。

meaning: n. 军团, 军队, 众多的人

examples.en: A Roman legion once marched along this quiet country road.
examples.zh: 一支罗马军团曾沿着这条安静的乡间道路行军。

meaning: a. 难懂的, 易忘的, 难以捉摸的

examples.en: Proof of the rare particle remained elusive for decades.
examples.zh: 这种稀有粒子的证据几十年来始终难以捕捉。

meaning: v. 避开, 躲避;n. 诡计, 躲藏

examples.en: Cyclists dodge potholes on the road to work every morning.
examples.zh: 骑车上班的人每天早晨都要躲避路上的坑洼。

examples.en: The announcement was met with widespread skepticism from industry analysts.
examples.zh: 业内分析人士对这一公告普遍持怀疑态度。

meaning: n. 体力劳动者, 辅助工;劳动者

examples.en: Each laborer on the site carries a helmet and safety boots.
examples.zh: 工地上的每名工人都佩戴安全帽并穿安全靴。

meaning: a. 行星的, 流浪的, 迁移不定的, 地球上的, 现世的

examples.en: The probe will study planetary atmospheres across the outer solar system.
examples.zh: 探测器将研究外太阳系的行星大气。

meaning: a. 不吉利的, 凶恶的, 左边的;左的

examples.en: The forest took on a sinister look as the fog thickened.
examples.zh: 雾越来越浓，森林显得阴森可怖。

meaning: a. 平滑的, 有光泽的

examples.en: The travel magazine prints glossy photos of remote island beaches.
examples.zh: 这本旅行杂志刊登偏远岛屿海滩的光鲜照片。

meaning: a. 高低不平的, 崎岖的, 粗糙的

examples.en: The island's rugged coastline draws kayakers from across the region.
examples.zh: 岛上崎岖的海岸线吸引着该地区的皮划艇爱好者。

meaning: a. 擦亮的, 优雅的, 精良的

examples.en: The dancers gave a polished performance after weeks of rehearsal.
examples.zh: 经过数周排练，舞者们奉献了一场娴熟的演出。

examples.en: Rising bread prices fueled popular discontent in the capital.
examples.zh: 面包涨价加剧了首都民众的不满。

meaning: a. 人与人之间的, 人际(关系)的;人与人之间的, 需要与他人接触的

examples.en: Strong interpersonal skills matter as much as technical knowledge in nursing.
examples.zh: 在护理行业，人际交往能力与技术知识同样重要。

examples.en: The region's income comes chiefly from tourism and small farming.
examples.zh: 该地区的收入主要来自旅游业和小农业。

meaning: a. 无情的, 冷酷的, 残酷的

examples.en: The team made a relentless push to finish the bridge before winter.
examples.zh: 团队不懈冲刺，力争入冬前建成大桥。

meaning: a. 母亲的, 母系的, 母方的;属母的, 母的, 母性的

examples.en: Her maternal instincts made her the natural leader of the nursery.
examples.zh: 她的母性本能使她成为托儿所当仁不让的负责人。

meaning: n. 欺骗, 诡计;瞒骗, 诈欺, 欺骗

examples.en: The novel explores how a single deception can unravel an entire family.
examples.zh: 小说探讨一个谎言如何瓦解整个家庭。

meaning: n. 真菌, 真菌类植物;真菌, 霉菌, , 蕈, 海绵肿

examples.en: A bright orange fungus grows on the fallen logs.
examples.zh: 一种鲜艳的橙色真菌生长在倒木上。

meaning: adv. 偶然地, 意外地

examples.en: He accidentally deleted the final draft an hour before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止时间前一小时，他不小心删除了终稿。

meaning: a. 天文学的, 庞大的

examples.en: The project's budget overruns reached astronomical figures within a single year.
examples.zh: 仅一年时间，项目预算超支就达到了天文数字。

examples.en: The central bank cautiously lowered interest rates amid signs of a slowdown.
examples.zh: 出现放缓迹象，央行谨慎地下调了利率。

meaning: n. 样子, 色度, 色彩, 叫声, 色调;色调

examples.en: The valley glows with a golden hue just before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前，山谷笼罩在金色的色调中。

meaning: n. 截取, 妨碍, 截距;vt. 拦截, 阻止, 截取

examples.en: Coast guards managed to intercept the smugglers' boat before dawn.
examples.zh: 海警在黎明前成功拦截了走私船。

meaning: a. 驰名的, 有名的

examples.en: The celebrated author rarely gives interviews or appears on television.
examples.zh: 这位享有盛誉的作家很少接受采访或上电视。

meaning: a. 污秽的, 丑恶的

examples.en: The inspectors closed the restaurant's filthy kitchen within an hour.
examples.zh: 检查员一小时内就查封了餐厅肮脏的厨房。

examples.en: As a novice cook, she stuck to simple recipes.
examples.zh: 作为烹饪新手，她只做简单的菜谱。

meaning: n. 无数, 无数的人(或物);a. 无数的, 种种的

examples.en: The reef supports a myriad of colorful marine species.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁养育着无数色彩斑斓的海洋物种。

meaning: a. 升空的, 空运的, 空中传播的, 空降的

examples.en: The pollen becomes airborne every spring and triggers allergies.
examples.zh: 花粉每年春天随风飘散，引发过敏。

meaning: n. 道德规范, 伦理

examples.en: A strong work ethic matters more than raw talent.
examples.zh: 强烈的职业道德比天赋更重要。

meaning: n. 可触知的东西, 有形资产;a. 可触摸的, 有实体的, 非相像的, 有形的, 明确的

examples.en: The training produced tangible gains in both speed and accuracy.
examples.zh: 培训在速度和准确性上都带来了实实在在的提升。

meaning: n. 菠菜, 货币, 胡说八道

examples.en: Fresh spinach loses much of its flavor when overcooked.
examples.zh: 新鲜菠菜煮过头会失去许多风味。

meaning: a. 有缺陷的, 欠缺的;n. 有缺陷的人, 不完全变化词

examples.en: The factory recalled thousands of defective air conditioning units.
examples.zh: 工厂召回了数千台有缺陷的空调。

meaning: n. 臼, 研钵, 灰泥;vt. 用灰泥涂抹, 用灰泥结合

examples.en: Workers mixed mortar on site to rebuild the brick wall.
examples.zh: 工人在现场搅拌灰浆以重砌砖墙。

meaning: a. 制止的, 威慑的, 遏制的;n. 威慑力量(或因素), 制止物

examples.en: High parking fees are an effective deterrent against city congestion.
examples.zh: 高昂的停车费是缓解城市拥堵的有效威慑手段。

meaning: n. 风味, 滋味, 少量, 拍击声, 咂嘴声, 小渔船, 海洛因;vi. 有味道, 咂嘴, 发出拍击声

examples.en: The tennis ball hit the fence with a loud smack.
examples.zh: 网球啪的一声重重撞在围栏上。

meaning: v. 连续猛打（尤其指妇女），猛击;n. 面糊（食物），击球员，打击手

examples.en: Winter storms batter the exposed cliffs along the northern coast.
examples.zh: 冬季风暴不断撞击北方海岸裸露的悬崖。

examples.en: The tailor pricked her fingertip while sewing the wedding dress.
examples.zh: 裁缝缝制婚纱时刺破了指尖。

meaning: n. 捐助, 天赋, 才能;捐赠, 捐款, 养老金

examples.en: The university's endowment funds new laboratories and student scholarships.
examples.zh: 大学的捐赠基金为新实验室和奖学金提供资金。

meaning: vt. 解释, 分析, 对...逐字直译;vi. 作句法分析

examples.en: Officials warned that silence might well be construed as agreement.
examples.zh: 官员警告说，沉默很可能被理解为同意。

meaning: vi. 休会, 换地方;vt. 使中止, 推迟

examples.en: The committee voted to adjourn until the auditors submit their findings.
examples.zh: 委员会投票决定休会，待审计人员提交结果后再继续。

meaning: n. 可见性, 能见度, 能见距离;可见性

examples.en: Heavy fog reduced visibility to a few meters on the highway.
examples.zh: 大雾使高速公路上的能见度降至几米。

meaning: n. 疯狂, 狂暴, 狂怒;暴怒, 狂乱

examples.en: The sale triggered a shopping frenzy that emptied the shelves.
examples.zh: 大促销引发了抢购狂潮，货架被一扫而空。

meaning: a. 光亮的, 华丽的

examples.en: Her silver bracelet was shining brightly under the restaurant lights.
examples.zh: 她的银手镯在餐厅灯光下闪闪发亮。

examples.en: The country gentry once dominated local politics in the shire.
examples.zh: 乡绅阶层曾一度主导该郡的地方政治。

meaning: a. 火山的, 猛烈的;n. 火山岩

examples.en: Rich volcanic soil makes the valley ideal for growing grapes.
examples.zh: 肥沃的火山土壤使山谷非常适合种植葡萄。

meaning: a. 有关处罚的, 刑的, 刑罚的, 刑法上的, (课税)繁重的;刑事的, 刑法的, 受刑罚的

examples.en: The reform bill favors rehabilitation over harsh penal measures.
examples.zh: 改革法案倾向于教育改造，而非严厉的刑罚措施。

meaning: vt. 重建, 改造;按原样修复

examples.en: Detectives used witness accounts to reconstruct the events of that night.
examples.zh: 警探借助目击者陈述重建了当晚的事件。

meaning: n. 闪烁, 闪光, 颤动;vi. 闪动, 闪烁, 摇动, 扑动翅膀

examples.en: Candlelight began to flicker as the cold draft entered the room.
examples.zh: 冷风灌入房间，烛光开始摇曳。

meaning: a. 聪明的, 有知识的

examples.en: The shop's knowledgeable staff can recommend books for any reader.
examples.zh: 书店知识渊博的店员能为任何读者荐书。

meaning: n. 筏, 救生筏, 大量;vi. 乘筏

examples.en: The explorers crossed the wide river on a simple bamboo raft.
examples.zh: 探险者们乘着简陋的竹筏渡过了宽阔的河流。

meaning: n. 山地, 高地, 高原;a. 高地的, 山地的

examples.en: Sheep graze on the windswept upland pastures all summer long.
examples.zh: 整个夏季，羊群都在风吹的高地牧场上吃草。

examples.en: Gentle swimming exercises help patients manage their arthritis pain.
examples.zh: 温和的游泳练习帮助病人缓解关节炎疼痛。

examples.en: The river's shifting course has moved the border over centuries.
examples.zh: 河流改道使边界在几个世纪里不断移动。

meaning: a. 营养的, 滋养的;营养的

examples.en: The label lists the nutritional content of every serving.
examples.zh: 标签列出了每份食品的营养成分。

meaning: n. 女权主义, 男女平等主义;男子女性

examples.en: Her dissertation traces feminism through three generations of local activists.
examples.zh: 她的论文追溯了三代当地活动家中的女权主义。

meaning: n. 悲叹, 悔恨, 恸哭, 挽歌, 悼词;vt. 哀悼

examples.en: Economists lament the decline of vocational training in public schools.
examples.zh: 经济学家感叹公立学校职业培训的衰落。

examples.en: The survey revealed a startling gap between rich and poor districts.
examples.zh: 调查揭示了贫富学区之间惊人的差距。

meaning: a. 混乱的, 无秩序的;混乱的, 混沌的

examples.en: The airport became chaotic after the storm canceled dozens of flights.
examples.zh: 风暴取消数十个航班后，机场陷入混乱。

meaning: a. 白热的, 灼热的, 通红的, 鲜艳的;辉光

examples.en: The play received glowing reviews from every major newspaper.
examples.zh: 这部剧得到了各大报纸的热烈好评。

meaning: n. 榛子, 榛树, 淡褐色;a. 榛树的, 淡褐色的

examples.en: The painter mixed warm tones to match her hazel eyes.
examples.zh: 画家调配暖色调来衬托她淡褐色的眼睛。

meaning: a. 狂乱的, 疯狂的

examples.en: Frantic parents searched every platform after losing sight of their son.
examples.zh: 与儿子走散后，心急如焚的父母搜遍了每个站台。

meaning: n. 下水道, 阴沟, 裁缝师;vt. 用下水道排, 铺设下水道于

examples.en: City workers spent days repairing the sewer beneath the main street.
examples.zh: 市政工人花了几天时间修理主干道下的下水道。

examples.en: Cooking for two hundred guests seemed daunting at first.
examples.zh: 为两百位客人做饭起初让人望而生畏。

meaning: n. 幼虫;幼虫(昆虫), 蚴(蠕虫)

examples.en: Each larva feeds on leaves for weeks before forming a cocoon.
examples.zh: 每条幼虫要吃数周树叶才结茧。

meaning: n. 触须, 触手, 触角;触角, 触须

examples.en: The octopus uses each tentacle to taste what it touches.
examples.zh: 章鱼用每条触手品尝它碰到的东西。

meaning: n. 大农场经营者, 牧场工人

examples.en: The rancher moves his cattle to higher ground every summer.
examples.zh: 牧场主每年夏天把牛群赶到地势更高的牧场。

examples.en: Poor air quality worsens respiratory illnesses among elderly city dwellers.
examples.zh: 空气质量差加重了城市老年人的呼吸系统疾病。

examples.en: Patients with diabetes may need insulin injections every single day.
examples.zh: 糖尿病患者可能每天都需要注射胰岛素。

examples.en: The old newspaper cost only a dime back in 1950.
examples.zh: 1950年时这份旧报纸只卖一角钱。

meaning: a. 诱惑人的, 吸引人的

examples.en: The tempting smell of fresh croissants drew customers into the bakery.
examples.zh: 新鲜牛角包诱人的香气把顾客引进了面包店。

meaning: a. 令人喜爱的, 愉快的, 舒适的

examples.en: The building's clean lines and pale stone have a pleasing symmetry.
examples.zh: 建筑简洁的线条和浅色石材呈现出悦目的对称。

meaning: a. 超然的, 分离的, 冷淡的;分遣的, 派遣的, 分离的

examples.en: The report takes a detached look at both sides of the dispute.
examples.zh: 报告以超然的视角审视争议双方。

meaning: n. 仇敌, 反对者, 敌人, 对手

examples.en: In the final chapter, the hero finally faces his old foe.
examples.zh: 在最后一章，主人公终于直面宿敌。

meaning: n. 粗石, 碎砖, 粗石堆

examples.en: Builders reused the rubble from the demolished wall as road base.
examples.zh: 建筑工人把拆墙产生的碎砖用作路基。

meaning: vt. 念咒文召唤, 变戏法, 想象;vi. 变戏法, 施魔法

examples.en: The old photographs conjure memories of summers spent at the lake.
examples.zh: 这些老照片唤起了在湖边度过的夏天的回忆。

meaning: v. 渴望, 热望, 恳求

examples.en: Students crave feedback that tells them exactly how to improve.
examples.zh: 学生渴望得到明确指出改进方向的反馈。

examples.en: The young playwright won a national award for her first drama.
examples.zh: 年轻剧作家凭首部剧作获得了全国奖项。

meaning: a. 精炼的, 优雅的, 精细的;精制过的, 精练过的

examples.en: Her refined manners impressed everyone at the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 她优雅的举止给正式晚宴上的每个人留下深刻印象。

meaning: vt. 使窒息, 抑止, 扼杀;vi. 窒息, 被扼杀

examples.en: Strict rules could stifle the creativity young designers clearly need.
examples.zh: 严苛的规定可能会扼杀年轻设计师明显需要的创造力。

meaning: n. 家具, 服饰品, 陈设品, 设备

examples.en: The cabin's rustic furnishing includes handmade chairs and a wool rug.
examples.zh: 小屋质朴的陈设包括手工椅子和一张羊毛地毯。

examples.en: Months of drought brought the reservoir to the brink of crisis.
examples.zh: 数月干旱使水库濒临危机边缘。

meaning: n. 付薪水的支票, 薪水

examples.en: A large share of each paycheck goes straight to rent.
examples.zh: 每份薪水的一大部分直接用于付房租。

meaning: n. 分裂, 崩溃, 解散, 解体;停止

examples.en: The breakup of the telecommunications giant took almost two years.
examples.zh: 这家电信巨头的拆分用了近两年时间。

meaning: n. 贪欲, 欲望, 色欲;vi. 贪求, 渴望, 动淫念

examples.en: The novel portrays the hero's lust for power and its costs.
examples.zh: 小说刻画了主人公对权力的欲望及其代价。

meaning: n. 迷宫, 迷惘;vt. 使迷惘, 使混乱, 迷失

examples.en: Visitors need a map to navigate the maze of narrow streets.
examples.zh: 游客需要地图才能穿过迷宫般的狭窄街巷。

meaning: n. 珠宝, 宝石, 珍贵之物;vt. 饰以宝石

examples.en: The small museum is a hidden gem loved by local artists.
examples.zh: 这家小博物馆是当地艺术家钟爱的隐藏瑰宝。

meaning: a. 发出音的, 读出来的, 显著的, 断然的, 明显的;显著的, 明显的, 明确的

examples.en: The north side of the valley shows a pronounced drop in rainfall.
examples.zh: 山谷北侧降雨量明显减少。

meaning: n. 闯入, 侵扰;突入

examples.en: Users complained that the new tracking feature felt like an intrusion.
examples.zh: 用户抱怨新追踪功能像是一种侵扰。

meaning: vt. 涉及, 含意, 暗示, 牵连;n. 包含的东西

examples.en: The leaked documents implicate several officials in the bribery scheme.
examples.zh: 泄露的文件牵涉数名官员卷入贿赂案。

meaning: n. 理解, 忧惧, 逮捕;领会

examples.en: She felt some apprehension before her first solo flight.
examples.zh: 第一次单人飞行前，她有些忧虑。

meaning: v. 请求, 乞求, 招揽, 征求

examples.en: The charity may not solicit donations without a special permit.
examples.zh: 没有特殊许可，慈善机构不得募捐。

examples.en: Voters need informed coverage of policy, not just political theater.
examples.zh: 选民需要的是有据可依的政策报道，而非政治作秀。

meaning: a. 快的, 迅速的;快的, 迅速的

examples.en: The clinic promises speedy treatment for minor injuries at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 诊所承诺午间快速诊治轻伤。

meaning: a. 可辨认的;可证明为同一的, 可以办清的

examples.en: Each whale has an identifiable pattern of markings on its tail.
examples.zh: 每头鲸鱼的尾鳍都有可辨认的斑纹图案。

meaning: a. 厨房的, 烹调用的

examples.en: The city is celebrated for its diverse culinary traditions.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其多元的烹饪传统而闻名。

meaning: a. 圆形的, 滚圆的, 完整的, 圆润的

examples.en: The program gives students a rounded education in both arts and sciences.
examples.zh: 该项目为学生提供文理兼备的全面教育。

meaning: n. 传说, 英雄传奇, 冒险故事

examples.en: The family saga follows three generations through war and rebuilding.
examples.zh: 这部家族史诗讲述了三代人经历战争与重建的故事。

meaning: n. 不重视, 无兴趣, 漠不关心;中立, 不偏袒, 不重视

examples.en: Officials were criticized for their indifference to the flooding victims.
examples.zh: 官员们因对洪灾受害者漠不关心而受到批评。

meaning: n. 验尸;尸体解剖, 尸体剖检

examples.en: The autopsy revealed that the singer died of natural causes.
examples.zh: 尸检表明这位歌手死于自然原因。

meaning: n. 灵魂, 精神, 普赛克(希腊神话中人类灵魂的化身);精神, 心灵

examples.en: The war left deep scars on the national psyche.
examples.zh: 战争在民族心理上留下了深深的伤痕。

meaning: n. 不平衡, 不均衡;不平衡, 失调

examples.en: A trade imbalance grew as imports rose faster than exports.
examples.zh: 进口增速快于出口，贸易失衡加剧。

meaning: a. 富有魅力的, 迷人的

examples.en: The documentary shows the less glamorous side of the fashion business.
examples.zh: 纪录片展现了时尚行业不那么光鲜的一面。

meaning: a. 被遗弃的, 废弃的;被遗弃的, 无人的, 放弃的

examples.en: The once busy beach lay deserted in the cold morning fog.
examples.zh: 寒冷晨雾中，曾经热闹的海滩空无一人。

meaning: vt. 吐露, 委托;vi. 信赖

examples.en: Patients often confide their worries to nurses before major surgery.
examples.zh: 病人在大手术前常向护士吐露忧虑。

meaning: a. 假装的, 做作的, 受影响的

examples.en: The affected families received emergency payments within days of the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水过后几天内，受灾家庭领到了应急补助金。

meaning: a. 生动的, 如画的, 独特的, 别致的, 栩栩如生的

examples.en: The picturesque harbor attracts painters who want to capture its quiet charm.
examples.zh: 风景如画的海港吸引着想描绘其静谧魅力的画家。

meaning: n. 抽象化, 心不在焉, 空想, 提炼, 抽象派作品;提取; 抽取; 夺取; 夺取反应; 除去

examples.en: The course moves from abstraction to concrete examples of market failures.
examples.zh: 课程从抽象概念过渡到市场失灵的具体案例。

meaning: a. 同类的, 同族的, 同源的

examples.en: Learning a language is akin to training for a marathon.
examples.zh: 学一门语言就像备战马拉松。

meaning: n. 发生, 起源, 创世记;生殖, 发生

examples.en: The documentary traces the genesis of the civil rights movement.
examples.zh: 纪录片追溯了民权运动的起源。

meaning: vi. 屈从, 屈服, 死

examples.en: Despite months of treatment, the patient finally succumbed to the illness.
examples.zh: 尽管治疗数月，病人最终还是被疾病击倒。

meaning: n. 身材, 身高, 高度;身材, 身高

examples.en: The director's stature in world cinema grew with every new film.
examples.zh: 这位导演在世界影坛的声望随每部新作而增长。

examples.en: The family walks in the woods behind their house most weekends.
examples.zh: 这家人大多数周末都在屋后的树林里散步。

meaning: a. 星的, 似星的, 星球的, 主要的

examples.en: The startup posted stellar results in only its second year.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司仅第二年就取得了出色的业绩。

meaning: n. 养生法, 常规强化训练课, 体制, 情态;制度, 生活制度

examples.en: The athlete follows a strict regimen of training, meals, and sleep.
examples.zh: 这名运动员遵循训练、饮食和睡眠的严格作息。

meaning: n. 取消, 作废, 注销戳;注销, 取消, 保险单的注销

examples.en: The airline texted passengers about the flight cancellation at midnight.
examples.zh: 航空公司午夜发短信通知乘客航班取消。

examples.en: The map shows the contour of every hill in bright lines.
examples.zh: 地图用明亮的线条标出了每座山的轮廓。

meaning: n. 腺, 密封套;衬片; 密封垫

examples.en: The thyroid gland controls how quickly the body uses energy.
examples.zh: 甲状腺控制着身体消耗能量的速度。

meaning: n. 描绘, 描写, 画像, 肖像;描绘

examples.en: Critics praised the actor's sensitive portrayal of the aging musician.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞演员对暮年音乐家的细腻演绎。

examples.en: Industrialized nations promised deeper cuts in carbon emissions by 2035.
examples.zh: 工业化国家承诺到2035年更大力度减排。

meaning: n. 斗篷, 罩子, 披风;vt. 罩住, 覆盖

examples.en: The mantle of leadership passed to the younger generation of engineers.
examples.zh: 领导重任交到了年轻一代工程师肩上。

meaning: n. 粉蜡笔, 粉蜡笔画, 随笔;a. 彩色蜡笔的, 蜡笔画的, 柔和的, 纤弱的

examples.en: The artist favors soft pastel shades in her beach paintings.
examples.zh: 这位画家在海滩画作中偏爱柔和的粉彩色调。

meaning: a. 不负责任的；不可靠的

examples.en: Leaving a campfire burning overnight is dangerous and deeply irresponsible.
examples.zh: 让营火通宵燃烧既危险又极不负责任。

examples.en: Neon signs lit up the narrow street after sunset.
examples.zh: 日落后，霓虹灯招牌点亮了狭窄的街道。

examples.en: The library staff categorize new books by subject and reading level.
examples.zh: 图书馆员工按主题和阅读难度为新书分类。

meaning: n. 运行, 运作；功能；机能；起酌（function的动名词）

examples.en: Regular checks keep the station's life support systems functioning smoothly.
examples.zh: 定期检查确保空间站生命维持系统平稳运转。

meaning: a. 衣衫褴褛的, 参差不齐的, 不协调的, 粗糙的, 刺耳的

examples.en: The refugees arrived in ragged clothes after weeks of walking.
examples.zh: 难民步行数周后衣衫褴褛地抵达。

meaning: a. 表达的, 富于表情的

examples.en: The dancers gave an expressive performance despite the tiny stage.
examples.zh: 尽管舞台狭小，舞者们仍奉献了富有表现力的演出。

meaning: n. 通风, 空气流通, 公开讨论;通风, 换气

examples.en: Poor ventilation in the workshop exposed workers to harmful dust.
examples.zh: 车间通风不良使工人接触有害粉尘。

meaning: n. 宗教信条, 教义, 纲领

examples.en: The charity serves families of every creed and background.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为各种信仰和背景的家庭提供帮助。

examples.en: Festive lanterns adorn the streets during the two-week harvest festival.
examples.zh: 为期两周的丰收节期间，街道上挂满了节日的灯笼。

meaning: a. 知觉的, 感觉的, 传递感觉的;感觉的

examples.en: The museum offers a sensory tour designed for visually impaired visitors.
examples.zh: 博物馆为视障游客提供感官体验之旅。

meaning: n. 心脏病患者, 强心剂, 健胃药;a. 心脏的, (胃的)贲门的

examples.en: The hospital opened a new cardiac unit for emergency heart cases.
examples.zh: 医院开设了新的心脏科病区以救治急症患者。

meaning: vt. 与...结婚, 使结合;vi. 结婚

examples.en: The couple plans to wed in a small ceremony by the sea.
examples.zh: 这对恋人计划在海边举行小型婚礼。

examples.en: Farmers plow the fields in early spring to prepare for planting.
examples.zh: 农民早春耕地，为播种做准备。

meaning: n. 绝缘；隔离, 孤立

examples.en: Better insulation can cut a home's heating bills by nearly half.
examples.zh: 更好的隔热措施能让家庭取暖费用减少近一半。

examples.en: He would brag about his marathon time to anyone who listened.
examples.zh: 他会向任何愿意听的人吹嘘自己的马拉松成绩。

meaning: n. 重打, 重击声;v. 重打, 撞击, 痛打

examples.en: A loud thump from the attic woke the whole family.
examples.zh: 阁楼传来一声闷响，吵醒了全家。

meaning: n. 狂喜, 心醉神迷, 忘形;入迷

examples.en: The fans were in ecstasy when the home team scored.
examples.zh: 主队进球时，球迷们欣喜若狂。

meaning: n. 终止, 结束, 结果, 词尾;终止

examples.en: The contract allows termination with one month's written notice.
examples.zh: 合同允许提前一个月书面通知终止。

meaning: n. 层, 地层, 阶层;层

examples.en: Archaeologists found bronze tools in the deepest stratum of the dig.
examples.zh: 考古学家在挖掘点的最深处地层发现了青铜工具。

meaning: n. 气氛, 气味;先兆

examples.en: The ancient temple has an aura of calm at dawn.
examples.zh: 古老的寺庙在黎明时分透着宁静的气息。

meaning: n. 上升, 提高, 攀登, 上坡路

examples.en: The ascent to the summit takes most climbers about six hours.
examples.zh: 登顶的攀登大多需要约六个小时。

meaning: vt. 使疏远, 离间, 转让;转让, 让与, 疏远

examples.en: Constant criticism can alienate even the most loyal team members.
examples.zh: 不断的批评甚至会疏远最忠诚的团队成员。

meaning: n. 獾, 獾皮毛;vt. 纠缠

examples.en: The children badger their grandfather to tell stories about the old days.
examples.zh: 孩子们缠着祖父讲过去的故事。

meaning: n. 再生, 重建;再生作用
